    function getScrollbarWidth() {
      // Creating invisible container
      const outer = document.createElement('div');
      outer.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      outer.style.overflow = 'scroll'; // forcing scrollbar to appear
      outer.style.msOverflowStyle = 'scrollbar'; // needed for WinJS apps
      document.documentElement.appendChild(outer);

      // Creating inner element and placing it in the container
      const inner = document.createElement('div');
      outer.appendChild(inner);

      // Calculating difference between container's full width and the child width
      const scrollbarWidth = outer.offsetWidth - inner.offsetWidth;

      // Removing temporary elements from the DOM
      outer.parentNode.removeChild(outer);

      return scrollbarWidth;
    }

<script>
  (() => {
    const root = document.getElementById("lab51-ab-announcement-lab51");
    if (!root) return;

    const mqMobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 749px)');

    const initDesktopItems = () => {
      const mode = root.dataset.mode;
      if (mode !== 'items') return;

      const itemsWrap = root.querySelector('[data-items]');
      if (!itemsWrap) return;

      const items = Array.from(itemsWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-item]'));
      if (!items.length) return;

      const prevBtn = root.querySelector('[data-prev]');
      const nextBtn = root.querySelector('[data-next]');

      const intervalValue = parseInt(root.dataset.interval || '35', 10); 
      const intervalMs = intervalValue * 100; 

      let idx = 0;
      let timer = null;

      const setActive = (i) => {
        idx = (i + items.length) % items.length;
        items.forEach((el, j) => el.classList.toggle('is-active', j === idx));
      };

      const next = () => setActive(idx + 1);
      const prev = () => setActive(idx - 1);

      const stop = () => { if (timer) clearInterval(timer); timer = null; };
      const start = () => {
        if (items.length <= 1) return;
        stop();
        if (intervalMs === 0) return;
        timer = setInterval(next, intervalMs);
      };

      setActive(0);
      start();

      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { prev(); start(); });
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { next(); start(); });

      root.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      root.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
      root.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
      root.addEventListener('focusout', start);

      document.addEventListener('shopify:section:unload', (e) => {
        if (e.detail && e.detail.sectionId === "announcement-lab51") stop();
      });
    };

    const initMobileItems = () => {
      const itemsWrap = root.querySelector('[data-items-mobile]');
      if (!itemsWrap) return;

      const items = Array.from(itemsWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-item-mobile]'));
      if (!items.length) return;

      const prevBtn = root.querySelector('[data-prev-mobile]');
      const nextBtn = root.querySelector('[data-next-mobile]');

      const intervalValue = parseInt(root.dataset.interval || '35', 10);
      const intervalMs = intervalValue * 100;

      let idx = 0;
      let timer = null;

      const setActive = (i) => {
        idx = (i + items.length) % items.length;
        items.forEach((el, j) => el.classList.toggle('is-active', j === idx));
      };

      const next = () => setActive(idx + 1);
      const prev = () => setActive(idx - 1);

      const stop = () => { if (timer) clearInterval(timer); timer = null; };
      const start = () => {
        if (items.length <= 1) return;
        stop();
        if (intervalMs === 0) return;
        timer = setInterval(next, intervalMs);
      };

      setActive(0);
      start();

      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { prev(); start(); });
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { next(); start(); });

      root.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
      root.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);

      document.addEventListener('shopify:section:unload', (e) => {
        if (e.detail && e.detail.sectionId === "announcement-lab51") stop();
      });
    };

    initDesktopItems();
    initMobileItems();

    mqMobile.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const mobileWrap = root.querySelector('[data-items-mobile]');
      if (mobileWrap) {
        const mobileItems = Array.from(mobileWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-item-mobile]'));
        if (mobileItems.length) mobileItems.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('is-active', i === 0));
      }
      const deskWrap = root.querySelector('[data-items]');
      if (deskWrap) {
        const deskItems = Array.from(deskWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-item]'));
        if (deskItems.length) deskItems.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('is-active', i === 0));
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // Trigger Desktop + Trigger Mobile (solo botones)
    const triggerDesktop = document.getElementById('ps-header');
    const triggerMobile  = document.getElementById('ps-header-mobile');
    if (!triggerDesktop && !triggerMobile) return;
  
    const body = document.body;
  
    // Reset puede existir solo en desktop, o en ambos
    const resetBtnDesktop  = triggerDesktop ? triggerDesktop.querySelector('[data-ps-reset]') : null;
    const resetBtnMobile   = triggerMobile  ? triggerMobile.querySelector('[data-ps-reset]') : null;
  
    // Botones submit (lupa) en desktop y mobile
    const submitBtnDesktop = triggerDesktop ? triggerDesktop.querySelector('[data-ps-submit]') : null;
    const submitBtnMobile  = triggerMobile  ? triggerMobile.querySelector('[data-ps-submit]') : null;
  
    // ============================================================
    // 1) Montar PORTAL una sola vez (si ya existe, reusar)
    // ============================================================
    const PORTAL_SELECTOR = '[data-ps-portal]';
    let portalBox = document.querySelector(PORTAL_SELECTOR);
  
    if (!portalBox) {
      const headerEl = document.querySelector('.theme__header') || document.querySelector('header');
      const tpl = document.getElementById('ps-header-panel-tpl') || document.getElementById('ps-header-panel-tpl'.replace('ps-header','ps-header')) || document.getElementById('ps-header-panel-tpl');
      if (!tpl) return;
  
      portalBox = tpl.content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
  
      if (headerEl) {
        if (getComputedStyle(headerEl).position === 'static') headerEl.style.position = 'relative';
        headerEl.appendChild(portalBox);
      } else {
        document.body.appendChild(portalBox);
      }
    }
  
    // Dentro del portal:
    const input      = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-input]');
    const emptyState = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-empty]');
    const liveState  = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-live]');
    const resultsBox = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-results]');
    const closeBtn   = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-close]');
    const loadingEl  = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-loading]');
    const footerEl   = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-footer]');
    const moreBtn    = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-more]');
    const fieldCloseBtn = portalBox.querySelector('[data-ps-field-close]');
    if (!input) return;
  
    // ============================================================
    // 2) Config predictivo
    // ============================================================
    const sectionId = 'predictive-search-render';
    const minChars = 1;
    const limit = 6;
  
    let lastQuery = '';
    let debounceTimer = null;
  
    function setLoading(on) {
      if (!loadingEl) return;
      loadingEl.hidden = !on;
    }
  
    function isOpen() {
      return body.classList.contains('ps-open') && portalBox.hidden === false;
    }
  
    function openPanel() {
      portalBox.hidden = false;
      input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      body.classList.add('ps-open');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  
    function closePanel() {
  portalBox.hidden = true;
  input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  body.classList.remove('ps-open');
  setLoading(false);
  if (fieldCloseBtn) fieldCloseBtn.hidden = true;
}
  
    function showEmptyState() {
      if (emptyState) emptyState.hidden = false;
      if (liveState) liveState.hidden = true;
      if (resultsBox) resultsBox.innerHTML = '';
      if (footerEl) footerEl.hidden = true;
    }
  
    function showLiveState() {
      if (emptyState) emptyState.hidden = true;
      if (liveState) liveState.hidden = false;
    }
  
    function buildUrl(q) {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      p.set('q', q);
      p.set('resources[type]', 'product');
      p.set('resources[limit]', String(limit));
      p.set('section_id', sectionId);
      p.set('resources[options][unavailable_products]', 'last');
      return `/search/suggest?${p.toString()}`;
    }
  
    function updateFooterLink(q) {
      if (!footerEl || !moreBtn) return;
  
      const term = (q || '').trim();
      if (!term) {
        footerEl.hidden = true;
        moreBtn.setAttribute('href', '#');
        return;
      }
  
      const searchUrl = `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&type=product`;
      moreBtn.setAttribute('href', searchUrl);
      moreBtn.textContent = `Ver más resultados para “${term}”`;
      footerEl.hidden = false;
    }
  
    async function fetchResults(q) {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        const res = await fetch(buildUrl(q), { credentials: 'same-origin' });
        const html = await res.text();
        if (resultsBox) resultsBox.innerHTML = html;
        updateFooterLink(q);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Predictive fetch error', e);
        if (resultsBox) resultsBox.innerHTML = '<div class="ps__empty">Sin resultados</div>';
        updateFooterLink(q);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  
    function goToSearch() {
      const q = (input.value || '').trim();
      if (q.length >= minChars) {
        window.location.href = `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&type=product`;
      }
    }
  
    // ============================================================
    // 3) Input listeners
    // ============================================================
    input.addEventListener('focus', () => {
      openPanel();
      showEmptyState();
    });
  
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
      openPanel();
  
      const q = input.value.trim();
  
      // Actualizar ambos resets si existen
      if (resetBtnDesktop) resetBtnDesktop.hidden = q.length === 0;
      if (resetBtnMobile)  resetBtnMobile.hidden  = q.length === 0;
      if (fieldCloseBtn) fieldCloseBtn.hidden = q.length === 0;
      if (q.length < minChars) {
        showEmptyState();
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
  
      showLiveState();
  
      if (q === lastQuery) return;
      lastQuery = q;
  
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => fetchResults(q), 180);
    });
  
    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        goToSearch();
      }
    });
  
    // ============================================================
    // 4) Click en BOTÓN DESKTOP o MOBILE => abrir o buscar
    // ============================================================
    function handleTriggerClick(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
  
      const term = (input.value || '').trim();
  
      if (!isOpen()) {
        openPanel();
        input.focus();
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus', { bubbles: true }));
        return;
      }
  
      if (!term) {
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
  
      goToSearch();
    }
  
    if (submitBtnDesktop) submitBtnDesktop.addEventListener('click', handleTriggerClick);
    if (submitBtnMobile)  submitBtnMobile.addEventListener('click', handleTriggerClick);
  
    // ============================================================
    // 5) Reset (si tienes reset en alguna vista)
    // ============================================================
    function handleResetClick(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      input.value = '';
      lastQuery = '';
      if (resetBtnDesktop) resetBtnDesktop.hidden = true;
      if (resetBtnMobile)  resetBtnMobile.hidden  = true;
      showEmptyState();
      input.focus();
    }
  
    if (resetBtnDesktop) resetBtnDesktop.addEventListener('click', handleResetClick);
    if (resetBtnMobile)  resetBtnMobile.addEventListener('click', handleResetClick);
  
    // ============================================================
    // 6) Cerrar: botón X, ESC, click fuera
    // ============================================================
    if (fieldCloseBtn) {
  fieldCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    input.value = '';
    lastQuery = '';
    if (resetBtnDesktop) resetBtnDesktop.hidden = true;
    if (resetBtnMobile)  resetBtnMobile.hidden  = true;
    fieldCloseBtn.hidden = true;
    closePanel();
  });
}
  
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !portalBox.hidden) {
        closePanel();
        input.blur();
      }
    });
  
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (portalBox.hidden) return;
  
      const insidePortal = portalBox.contains(e.target);
      const insideDesktop = triggerDesktop ? triggerDesktop.contains(e.target) : false;
      const insideMobile  = triggerMobile  ? triggerMobile.contains(e.target) : false;
  
      if (!insidePortal && !insideDesktop && !insideMobile) closePanel();
    });
  
    // ============================================================
    // 7) Chips => set term + fetch
    // ============================================================
    portalBox.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const chip = e.target.closest('[data-ps-chip]');
      if (!chip) return;
  
      e.preventDefault();
      const term = (chip.getAttribute('data-term') || '').trim();
      if (!term) return;
  
      input.value = term;
      lastQuery = term;
  
      if (resetBtnDesktop) resetBtnDesktop.hidden = false;
      if (resetBtnMobile)  resetBtnMobile.hidden  = false;
  
      openPanel();
      showLiveState();
      fetchResults(term);
    });
  
    // ============================================================
    // 8) Safe-zone / cerrar al entrar al menú
    // ============================================================
    const menuList = document.querySelector('.header__menu-list');
    const MARGIN = 50;
  
    function isVisible(el) {
      if (!el) return false;
      if (el.hidden) return false;
      const st = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (st.display === 'none' || st.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return r.width > 2 && r.height > 2;
    }
  
    function insideWithMargin(el, x, y) {
      if (!el) return false;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return x >= r.left - MARGIN && x <= r.right + MARGIN && y >= r.top - MARGIN && y <= r.bottom + MARGIN;
    }
  
    function inSafeZone(x, y) {
      const inPortal = isVisible(portalBox) && insideWithMargin(portalBox, x, y);
      const inDesktop = triggerDesktop && insideWithMargin(triggerDesktop, x, y);
      const inMobile  = triggerMobile  && insideWithMargin(triggerMobile, x, y);
      return inPortal || inDesktop || inMobile;
    }
  
    if (menuList) {
      menuList.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => {
        if (body.classList.contains('ps-open')) closePanel();
      }, { passive: true });
    }
  
    let rafId = null;
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
      if (!body.classList.contains('ps-open')) return;
      if (rafId) return;
  
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rafId = null;
        if (inSafeZone(e.clientX, e.clientY)) return;
        closePanel();
      });
    }, { passive: true });
  });
</script>
  </header>
</header-component>

<script>
  (function(){
    const root = document.querySelector('[data-mm51-root]');
    if(!root) return;
  
    const drawer  = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-drawer]');
    const overlay = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-overlay]');
    const closeBtn= root.querySelector('[data-mm51-close]');
  
    const openBtn = document.querySelector('[data-mm51-open]');
    const openSearchBtn = document.querySelector('[data-mm51-open-search]');
  
    const links = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-mm51-link]'));
    const panels = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-mm51-panel]'));
  
    const searchInput = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-search]');
    const resultsWrap = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-results-wrap]');
    const resultsList = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-results]');
    const footer = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-footer]');
    const moreBtn = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-more]');
    const searchMenus = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-search-menus]');
  
    const minChars = 1;
    const limit = 6;
    let debounceId = null;

    if (moreBtn) {
  moreBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const href = moreBtn.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href === '#') {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    e.preventDefault();     // cortamos bubbling raro
    closeDrawer();
    window.location.assign(href); // navegación forzada
  });
}
  
    function lockScroll(on){
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('mm51m-no-scroll', on);
      document.body.classList.toggle('mm51m-no-scroll', on);
    }
  
    function normalize(str){
      return (str || '')
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'')
        .replace(/\s+/g,' ');
    }
  
    function setActiveLink(a){
      links.forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('is-active', x === a));
    }
  
    function findPanelForTitle(title){
      const t = normalize(title);
      return panels.find(p => normalize(p.getAttribute('data-mm51-match')) === t) || null;
    }
  
    function activatePanel(panel){
      panels.forEach(p=>{
        const on = (p === panel);
        p.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
        p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
      });
    }
  
    function showSearch(){
      if(resultsWrap) resultsWrap.classList.add('is-active');
      const panelsRoot = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-panels]');
      if(panelsRoot) panelsRoot.style.display = 'none';
    }
  
    function showPanels(){
      if(resultsWrap) resultsWrap.classList.remove('is-active');
      const panelsRoot = root.querySelector('[data-mm51-panels]');
      if(panelsRoot) panelsRoot.style.display = 'block';
    }
  
    function toggleSearchMenus(show){
      if(searchMenus) searchMenus.hidden = !show;
      if(resultsList) resultsList.style.display = show ? 'none' : 'block';
      if(footer) footer.hidden = show ? true : footer.hidden; // en modo menús siempre oculto
    }
  
    function clearSearchUI(){
      if(resultsList) resultsList.innerHTML = '';
      if(footer) footer.hidden = true;
      if(moreBtn) moreBtn.href = '#';
      if(searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
      toggleSearchMenus(true); // vuelve a mostrar menús
    }
  
    function openDrawer(mode){
      if(!drawer) return;
      drawer.classList.add('is-open');
      drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  
      if(overlay){
        overlay.hidden = false;
        overlay.classList.add('is-open');
      }
      lockScroll(true);
  
      if(mode === 'search'){
        showSearch();
        toggleSearchMenus(true); // <-- MENUS visibles antes de escribir
        setTimeout(()=>searchInput && searchInput.focus(), 0);
      }else{
        showPanels();
  
        const firstWithPanel = links.find(a => {
          const title = a.getAttribute('data-mm51-title') || a.textContent;
          return !!findPanelForTitle(title);
        });
  
        if(firstWithPanel){
          activateByLink(firstWithPanel, true);
        }else{
          const first = links[0];
          if(first) setActiveLink(first);
        }
      }
    }
  
    function closeDrawer(){
      if(!drawer) return;
      drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
      drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  
      if(overlay){
        overlay.classList.remove('is-open');
        setTimeout(()=>{ overlay.hidden = true; }, 200);
      }
      lockScroll(false);
      clearSearchUI();
    }
  
    function activateByLink(a, force){
      const title = a.getAttribute('data-mm51-title') || a.textContent;
      const href  = a.getAttribute('href') || '#';
      const panel = findPanelForTitle(title);
  
      setActiveLink(a);
  
      if(!panel){
        if(!force) window.location.assign(href);
        return;
      }
  
      showPanels();
      activatePanel(panel);
    }
  
    openBtn && openBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>openDrawer('menu'));
    openSearchBtn && openSearchBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>openDrawer('search'));
    closeBtn && closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    overlay && overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if(e.key === 'Escape' && drawer && drawer.classList.contains('is-open')) closeDrawer();
    });
  
    links.forEach(a=>{
      a.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
        e.preventDefault();
        activateByLink(a, false);
      });
    });
  
    function moneyFromCents(cents){
      if(cents == null) return '';
      try{
        const n = Number(cents) / 100;
        return new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {
          style:'currency',
          currency: (window.Shopify && Shopify.currency && Shopify.currency.active) || 'CLP'
        }).format(n);
      }catch(e){
        return '';
      }
    }
  
    function updateFooter(q){
      if(!footer || !moreBtn) return;
      const term = (q || '').trim();
      if(!term){
        footer.hidden = true;
        moreBtn.href = '#';
        return;
      }
      footer.hidden = false;
      moreBtn.textContent = `Ver todos los resultados para “${term}”`;
      moreBtn.href = `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&type=product`;
    }
  
    async function fetchSuggest(q){
      const url = `/search/suggest.json?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&resources[type]=product&resources[limit]=${limit}&resources[options][unavailable_products]=show`;
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials:'same-origin' });
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error('suggest failed');
      return res.json();
    }
  
    function renderResults(data, q){
      const products = data && data.resources && data.resources.results && data.resources.results.products
        ? data.resources.results.products
        : [];
  
      if(!resultsList) return;
  
      if(!products.length){
        resultsList.innerHTML = `<li class="mm51m__results-item"><div style="color:#666;">Sin resultados</div></li>`;
        updateFooter(q);
        return;
      }
  
      resultsList.innerHTML = products.map(p => {
  const img = (p.featured_image && p.featured_image.url) ? p.featured_image.url : '';
  

  const rawPrice = (p.price != null) ? p.price : 0;
  const formattedPrice = new Intl.NumberFormat('es-CL').format(rawPrice);

  return `
    <li class="mm51m__results-item">
      <a href="${p.url}">
        <span class="mm51m__results-thumb">${img ? `<img src="${img}" alt="">` : ''}</span>
        <span class="mm51m__results-meta">
          <span class="mm51m__results-title">${(p.title || '').replace(/</g,'&lt;')}</span>
          ${p.price != null ? `<span class="mm51m__results-price">$${formattedPrice}</span>` : ``}
        </span>
      </a>
    </li>
  `;
}).join('');
  
      updateFooter(q);
    }
  
    function doSearch(q){
      const term = (q || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
  
      // SIN TEXTO -> menús visibles, sin resultados
      if(term.length < minChars){
        if(resultsList) resultsList.innerHTML = '';
        if(footer) footer.hidden = true;
        toggleSearchMenus(true);
        return;
      }
  
      // CON TEXTO -> ocultar menús, mostrar resultados
      toggleSearchMenus(false);
      showSearch();
  
      clearTimeout(debounceId);
      debounceId = setTimeout(async ()=>{
        try{
          const data = await fetchSuggest(term);
          renderResults(data, term);
        }catch(err){
          if(resultsList) resultsList.innerHTML = `<li class="mm51m__results-item"><div style="color:#666;">Sin resultados</div></li>`;
          updateFooter(term);
        }
      }, 160);
    }
  
    searchInput && searchInput.addEventListener('focus', ()=>{
      showSearch();
      const q = (searchInput.value || '').trim();
      if(q.length < minChars) toggleSearchMenus(true);
    });
  
    searchInput && searchInput.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
      doSearch(searchInput.value);
    });
  
    searchInput && searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
      if(e.key === 'Enter'){
        e.preventDefault();
        const q = (searchInput.value || '').trim();
        if(q.length >= minChars){
          window.location.assign(`/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&type=product`);
        }
      }
    });
  
  })();
  </script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    function syncCloseWidth() {
      const nav = document.querySelector('.mm51m__nav');
      const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.mm51m__close');
  
      if (!nav || !closeBtn) return;
  
      const navWidth = nav.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      closeBtn.style.width = navWidth + 'px';
    }
  
    // Al cargar
    syncCloseWidth();
  
    // Al redimensionar
    window.addEventListener('resize', syncCloseWidth);
  
    // Si el drawer se abre dinámicamente
    document.addEventListener('mm51m:open', syncCloseWidth);
  });
  </script>

</div>
        
        
      </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      if (window.__shareCartGlobalModalInitialized) return;
      window.__shareCartGlobalModalInitialized = true;

      const modal = document.querySelector(
        '[data-share-cart-modal]'
      );

      if (!modal) return;

      const input = modal.querySelector(
        '[data-share-cart-link]'
      );

      const copyButton = modal.querySelector(
        '[data-share-cart-copy]'
      );

      const copyText = modal.querySelector(
        '[data-share-cart-copy-text]'
      );

      const message = modal.querySelector(
        '[data-share-cart-message]'
      );

      let lastFocusedElement = null;
      let closeTimer = null;

      function getRootUrl() {
        const root =
          window.Shopify?.routes?.root || '/';

        return root.endsWith('/')
          ? root
          : root + '/';
      }

      function setMessage(text) {
        if (message) {
          message.textContent = text || '';
        }
      }

      function resetCopyButton() {
        if (closeTimer) {
          window.clearTimeout(closeTimer);
          closeTimer = null;
        }

        if (copyButton) {
          copyButton.disabled = false;
        }

        if (copyText) {
          copyText.textContent =
            "Copiar link";
        }

        setMessage('');
      }

      async function createShareUrl() {
        setMessage('');

        const response = await fetch(
          getRootUrl() + 'cart.js',
          {
            method: 'GET',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            headers: {
              Accept: 'application/json'
            }
          }
        );

        const cart = await response
          .json()
          .catch(function () {
            return {};
          });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(
            cart.description ||
            cart.message ||
            'No fue posible obtener el carrito.'
          );
        }

        if (
          !cart.items ||
          cart.items.length === 0
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            'Tu carrito está vacío.'
          );
        }

        const items = cart.items.map(
          function (item) {
            return (
              item.variant_id +
              ':' +
              item.quantity
            );
          }
        );

        const shareUrl = new URL(
          getRootUrl() + 'cart',
          window.location.origin
        );

        shareUrl.searchParams.set(
          'share_cart',
          items.join(',')
        );

        if (input) {
          input.value = shareUrl.toString();
        }
      }

      async function openModal(trigger) {
        lastFocusedElement = trigger;

        resetCopyButton();

        trigger?.setAttribute(
          'aria-expanded',
          'true'
        );

        trigger?.setAttribute(
          'aria-busy',
          'true'
        );

        try {
          await createShareUrl();

          modal.hidden = false;

          document.body.classList.add(
            'share-cart-is-open'
          );

          requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            modal
              .querySelector(
                '.share-cart-modal__close'
              )
              ?.focus();
          });
        } catch (error) {
          trigger?.setAttribute(
            'aria-expanded',
            'false'
          );

          setMessage(
            error.message ||
            'No fue posible crear el link.'
          );

          console.error(
            '[Compartir carrito]',
            error
          );
        } finally {
          trigger?.removeAttribute(
            'aria-busy'
          );
        }
      }

      function closeModal() {
        if (closeTimer) {
          window.clearTimeout(closeTimer);
          closeTimer = null;
        }

        modal.hidden = true;

        document.body.classList.remove(
          'share-cart-is-open'
        );

        setMessage('');

        if (copyButton) {
          copyButton.disabled = false;
        }

        if (copyText) {
          copyText.textContent =
            "Copiar link";
        }

        if (lastFocusedElement) {
          lastFocusedElement.setAttribute(
            'aria-expanded',
            'false'
          );

          if (
            document.documentElement.contains(
              lastFocusedElement
            )
          ) {
            lastFocusedElement.focus();
          }
        }

        lastFocusedElement = null;
      }

      async function copyShareUrl() {
        if (!input?.value || !copyButton) return;

        const originalText =
          copyText?.textContent?.trim() ||
          "Copiar link";

        copyButton.disabled = true;
        setMessage('');

        try {
          if (
            navigator.clipboard &&
            window.isSecureContext
          ) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(
              input.value
            );
          } else {
            input.focus();
            input.select();

            input.setSelectionRange(
              0,
              input.value.length
            );

            const copied =
              document.execCommand('copy');

            if (!copied) {
              throw new Error(
                'No fue posible copiar el link.'
              );
            }
          }

          if (copyText) {
            copyText.textContent =
              'Link copiado';
          }

          setMessage(
            'El link fue copiado correctamente.'
          );

          closeTimer = window.setTimeout(
            function () {
              if (copyText) {
                copyText.textContent =
                  originalText;
              }

              copyButton.disabled = false;
              setMessage('');
              closeModal();
            },
            2000
          );
        } catch (error) {
          setMessage(
            error.message ||
            'No fue posible copiar el link.'
          );

          copyButton.disabled = false;
        }
      }

      document.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function (event) {
          const openTrigger =
            event.target.closest(
              '[data-share-cart-open]'
            );

          if (openTrigger) {
            event.preventDefault();
            openModal(openTrigger);
            return;
          }

          const closeTrigger =
            event.target.closest(
              '[data-share-cart-close]'
            );

          if (
            closeTrigger &&
            closeTrigger.closest(
              '[data-share-cart-modal]'
            )
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();
            closeModal();
            return;
          }

          const copyTrigger =
            event.target.closest(
              '[data-share-cart-copy]'
            );

          if (
            copyTrigger &&
            copyTrigger.closest(
              '[data-share-cart-modal]'
            )
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();
            copyShareUrl();
          }
        }
      );

      document.addEventListener(
        'keydown',
        function (event) {
          if (
            event.key === 'Escape' &&
            !modal.hidden
          ) {
            closeModal();
          }
        }
      );
    })();
  </script>

<script>
  (function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-l51-card-slider]').forEach(function(root){

      const viewport = root.querySelector('[data-l51-viewport]');
      const track = root.querySelector('[data-l51-track]');
      const btnPrev = root.querySelector('[data-l51-prev]');
      const btnNext = root.querySelector('[data-l51-next]');
      const dotsWrap = root.querySelector('[data-l51-dots]');
      if (!viewport || !track) return;

      viewport.style.touchAction = 'pan-y pinch-zoom';

      const realSlides = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('[data-l51-real-slide]'));
      if (realSlides.length < 2) return;

      let clonesN = 0;
      let index = 0;
      let slideW = 0;
      let gap = 0;
      let rafResize = null;

      function markMoved(){
        viewport.classList.remove('is-start');
      }

      function getGapPx(){
        const st = getComputedStyle(track);
        const g = st.gap || st.columnGap || '0px';
        const n = parseFloat(g);
        return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
      }

      function measure(){
        gap = getGapPx();

        if (!realSlides[0]) {
          slideW = 0;
          clonesN = 0;
          return;
        }

        slideW = realSlides[0].getBoundingClientRect().width || 0;
        const vpW = viewport.getBoundingClientRect().width || 0;
        const unit = slideW + gap;
        const perView = unit > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(vpW / unit)) : 1;
        clonesN = Math.min(realSlides.length, perView + 1);
      }

      function clearClones(){
        track.querySelectorAll('[data-l51-clone]').forEach((n) => n.remove());
      }

      function buildClones(){
        clearClones();

        const before = document.createDocumentFragment();
        const after = document.createDocumentFragment();

        const head = realSlides.slice(0, clonesN);
        const tail = realSlides.slice(-clonesN);

        tail.forEach((s) => {
          const c = s.cloneNode(true);
          c.setAttribute('data-l51-clone', '');
          c.removeAttribute('data-l51-real-slide');
          before.appendChild(c);
        });

        head.forEach((s) => {
          const c = s.cloneNode(true);
          c.setAttribute('data-l51-clone', '');
          c.removeAttribute('data-l51-real-slide');
          after.appendChild(c);
        });

        track.prepend(before);
        track.append(after);
      }

      function setAnim(on){
        track.classList.toggle('is-anim', !!on);
      }

      function setPos(i, animate){
        setAnim(animate);
        const x = (slideW + gap) * i;
        track.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (-x) + 'px,0,0)';
      }

      function realIndexFromIndex(i){
        const r = realSlides.length;
        const v = (i - clonesN) % r;
        return (v + r) % r;
      }

      function setActiveDotByIndex(i){
        if (!dotsWrap) return;
        const dots = dotsWrap.querySelectorAll('.l51-dot');
        const ri = realIndexFromIndex(i);
        dots.forEach((d, di) => d.classList.toggle('is-active', di === ri));
      }

      function buildDots(){
        if (!dotsWrap) return;

        dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';

        realSlides.forEach((_, i) => {
          const b = document.createElement('button');
          b.type = 'button';
          b.className = 'l51-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
          b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Ir a slide ' + (i + 1));

          b.addEventListener('click', () => {
            markMoved();
            index = clonesN + i;
            setPos(index, true);
            setActiveDotByIndex(index);
          });

          dotsWrap.appendChild(b);
        });
      }

      function normalizeIfNeeded(){
        const r = realSlides.length;
        const min = clonesN;
        const max = clonesN + r - 1;

        if (index > max) {
          index = min + (index - max - 1);
          setPos(index, false);
        } else if (index < min) {
          index = max - (min - index - 1);
          setPos(index, false);
        }

        setActiveDotByIndex(index);
      }

      function goNext(){
        markMoved();
        index += 1;
        setPos(index, true);
        setActiveDotByIndex(index);
      }

      function goPrev(){
        markMoved();
        index -= 1;
        setPos(index, true);
        setActiveDotByIndex(index);
      }

      if (btnNext) {
        btnNext.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          goNext();
        });
      }

      if (btnPrev) {
        btnPrev.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          goPrev();
        });
      }

      track.addEventListener('transitionend', (e) => {
        if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
        normalizeIfNeeded();
      });

      let isDown = false;
      let startX = 0;
      let startY = 0;
      let lastX = 0;
      let lastY = 0;
      let baseX = 0;
      let dragged = false;
      let didDrag = false;
      let lockAxis = null;
      let lastMoveTime = 0;
      let velocityX = 0;
      let activePointerId = null;
      let startLink = null;

      function currentTranslateX(){
        const st = getComputedStyle(track).transform;
        if (!st || st === 'none') return 0;

        const m = st.match(/matrix(3d)?\((.+)\)/);
        if (!m) return 0;

        const parts = m[2].split(',').map((v) => parseFloat(v.trim()));
        return m[1] === '3d' ? (parts[12] || 0) : (parts[4] || 0);
      }

      function isBlockedTarget(el){
        return !!(
          el &&
          el.closest('button, input, select, textarea, label, [role="button"], [data-quick-add], [data-open-quickadd]')
        );
      }

      function stopNativeDrag(rootEl){
        rootEl.querySelectorAll('img, a').forEach((el) => {
          el.setAttribute('draggable', 'false');
        });
      }

      function navigateToLink(link, e){
        if (!link) return;

        const href = link.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href || href === '#') return;
        if (link.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;

        if (e && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
          window.open(href, '_blank');
          return;
        }

        const target = link.getAttribute('target');
        if (target === '_blank') {
          window.open(href, '_blank');
          return;
        }

        window.location.href = href;
      }

      function onPointerMove(e){
        if (!isDown) return;
        if (activePointerId !== null && e.pointerId !== activePointerId) return;

        const dx = e.clientX - startX;
        const dy = e.clientY - startY;
        const now = performance.now();

        if (!lockAxis) {
          if (Math.abs(dx) < 2 && Math.abs(dy) < 2) return;
          lockAxis = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? 'x' : 'y';
        }

        if (lockAxis !== 'x') return;

        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();

        if (Math.abs(dx) > 6) {
          dragged = true;
          didDrag = true;
          startLink = null;
        }

        const dt = now - lastMoveTime;
        if (dt > 0) {
          velocityX = (e.clientX - lastX) / dt;
        }

        lastX = e.clientX;
        lastY = e.clientY;
        lastMoveTime = now;

        track.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (baseX + dx) + 'px,0,0)';
      }

      function endDrag(e){
        if (!isDown) return;
        if (activePointerId !== null && e.pointerId !== activePointerId) return;

        isDown = false;
        activePointerId = null;

        const dx = lastX - startX;
        const dy = lastY - startY;
        const absV = Math.abs(velocityX);
        const threshold = Math.max(18, Math.min(55, slideW * 0.12));
        const flickVelocity = 0.22;
        const wasTap = !dragged && Math.abs(dx) < 6 && Math.abs(dy) < 6;

        if (!dragged || lockAxis !== 'x') {
          setAnim(false);
          track.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + baseX + 'px,0,0)';

          if (wasTap && startLink) {
            navigateToLink(startLink, e);
          }

          dragged = false;
          startLink = null;
          return;
        }

        if (dx <= -threshold || (dx < 0 && absV >= flickVelocity)) {
          goNext();
        } else if (dx >= threshold || (dx > 0 && absV >= flickVelocity)) {
          goPrev();
        } else {
          setPos(index, true);
        }

        dragged = false;
        startLink = null;
      }

      viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
        if (isBlockedTarget(e.target)) return;

        isDown = true;
        dragged = false;
        didDrag = false;
        lockAxis = null;
        activePointerId = e.pointerId;
        startLink = e.target.closest('a[href]');

        startX = e.clientX;
        startY = e.clientY;
        lastX = startX;
        lastY = startY;
        baseX = currentTranslateX();
        lastMoveTime = performance.now();
        velocityX = 0;

        setAnim(false);
      });

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
      window.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag, { passive: true });

      viewport.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        if (!didDrag) return;

        const a = e.target.closest('a');
        if (a) e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();

        didDrag = false;
      }, true);

      function init(){
        measure();
        buildClones();
        buildDots();
        stopNativeDrag(root);

        index = clonesN;
        setPos(index, false);
        setActiveDotByIndex(index);

        viewport.classList.add('is-start');
      }

      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        if (rafResize) cancelAnimationFrame(rafResize);
        rafResize = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          init();
        });
      });

      init();
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const sectionContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.cis-section-template--28339046318376__lab51_blog_slider_8W7mQe');
    
    sectionContainers.forEach(container => {
      const sliderContainer = container.querySelector('.cis-slider-container');
      const track = container.querySelector('.cis-track');
      const realSlides = track.querySelectorAll('.cis-slide:not(.is-empty)');
      const activateBtn = track.querySelector('.cis-activate-btn');
      const uiNextBtn = container.querySelector('.cis-nav-btn.next'); 
      const prevBtn = container.querySelector('.cis-nav-btn.prev');
      const dotsContainer = container.querySelector('.cis-dots');
      
      let dots = [];
      let validSlidesCount = 0;
      let currentActiveIndex = 0;

      const getSlideScrollTarget = (slide) => {
        const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
        if (isMobile) {
          return slide.offsetLeft - (track.clientWidth / 2) + (slide.clientWidth / 2);
        } else {
          return slide.offsetLeft - (track.clientWidth * 0.1);
        }
      };

      const buildDots = () => {
        dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
        dots = [];

        const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
        validSlidesCount = isMobile ? realSlides.length : Math.max(1, realSlides.length - 2);

        for (let i = 0; i < validSlidesCount; i++) {
          const slide = realSlides[i];
          const dot = document.createElement('button');
          dot.className = 'cis-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
          
          dot.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (i === 0 && !isMobile) {
              sliderContainer.classList.remove('is-active');
              track.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
            } else {
              if (!sliderContainer.classList.contains('is-active') && !isMobile) {
                sliderContainer.classList.add('is-active');
              }
              setTimeout(() => {
                track.scrollTo({ left: getSlideScrollTarget(slide), behavior: 'smooth' });
              }, (!sliderContainer.classList.contains('is-active') && !isMobile) ? 50 : 0);
            }
          });
          
          dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
          dots.push(dot);
        }
      };

      const updateUI = () => {
        const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
        if (!sliderContainer.classList.contains('is-active') && !isMobile) {
          currentActiveIndex = 0;
          dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
          return;
        }

        const currentScroll = track.scrollLeft;
        let activeIndex = 0;
        let minDiff = Infinity;

        for (let i = 0; i < validSlidesCount; i++) {
          const slide = realSlides[i];
          const target = getSlideScrollTarget(slide);
          const diff = Math.abs(currentScroll - target);
          if (diff < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff;
            activeIndex = i;
          }
        }

        currentActiveIndex = activeIndex;
        dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activeIndex));
      };

      const initMobile = () => {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 900) {
          sliderContainer.classList.add('is-active');
          if (realSlides[1]) {
            track.scrollTo({ left: getSlideScrollTarget(realSlides[1]), behavior: 'auto' });
          }
        }
      };

      buildDots();
      initMobile();

      window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        buildDots();
        initMobile();
        updateUI();
      });

      activateBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
        
        if (!sliderContainer.classList.contains('is-active') && !isMobile) {
          sliderContainer.classList.add('is-active');
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (realSlides[1]) track.scrollTo({ left: getSlideScrollTarget(realSlides[1]), behavior: 'smooth' });
          }, 50); 
        } else if (isMobile) {
          if (realSlides[1]) track.scrollTo({ left: getSlideScrollTarget(realSlides[1]), behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });

      if (uiNextBtn) {
        uiNextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
          const scrollDistance = isMobile ? track.clientWidth * 0.85 : track.clientWidth * 0.275;
          track.scrollBy({ left: scrollDistance + 15, behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
      }

      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 900;
          
          if (!isMobile) {
            if (currentActiveIndex === 0) {
              sliderContainer.classList.remove('is-active');
              track.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
              return;
            }
          }
          
          const scrollDistance = isMobile ? track.clientWidth * 0.85 : track.clientWidth * 0.275;
          track.scrollBy({ left: -(scrollDistance + 15), behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
      }

      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateUI);
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const BREAKPOINT = 749;

    const footerGroup = document.querySelector('.container-group-footer-info');
    const mobileTarget = document.querySelector('.container-info-newsletter-mobile');

    if (!footerGroup || !mobileTarget) return;

    // Placeholder para devolver el elemento a su lugar original
    const placeholder = document.createComment('container-group-footer-info-placeholder');
    const originalParent = footerGroup.parentNode;
    const originalNext = footerGroup.nextSibling;

    // Insertamos placeholder donde estaba originalmente
    originalParent.insertBefore(placeholder, originalNext);

    function moveByBreakpoint() {
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= BREAKPOINT;

      if (isMobile) {
        if (!mobileTarget.contains(footerGroup)) {
          mobileTarget.appendChild(footerGroup);
        }
      } else {
        // Volver a su posición original
        if (placeholder.parentNode) {
          placeholder.parentNode.insertBefore(footerGroup, placeholder.nextSibling);
        }
      }
    }

    // Init
    moveByBreakpoint();

    // Reaccionar a resize
    let resizeRAF = null;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (resizeRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(resizeRAF);
      resizeRAF = requestAnimationFrame(moveByBreakpoint);
    });
  })();
</script>

    <script> 
      (() => {
        if (window.__onlyClickSwatchesPatched) return;
        window.__onlyClickSwatchesPatched = true;
      
        const SECTION_ID      = window.PRODUCT_CARD_SECTION_ID || 'api-product-grid-item';
        const SEL_CARD        = 'product-item, [data-grid-item]';
        const SEL_SWATCH      = '[data-sibling-link]'; // swatches que cambian de producto
        const SEL_GRID_SWATCH = '[data-variant-name], [data-variant-title], [data-swatch-button]'; // swatches que cambian imagen
      
        /* ---------------------------
         * 1) Strip de listeners hover
         * --------------------------- */
        function stripHoverFromSwatches(root = document) {
          // Quita listeners previos clonando nodos de swatches
          root.querySelectorAll(SEL_SWATCH + ',' + SEL_GRID_SWATCH).forEach((oldEl) => {
            const newEl = oldEl.cloneNode(true);
            oldEl.replaceWith(newEl);
          });
      
          // Bloquea hovers SOLO dentro de cards de producto
          const killHover = (e) => {
            const t = e.target;
            if (!(t instanceof Element)) return;              // <-- evita error de closest()
            const inCard = t.closest(SEL_CARD);
            if (!inCard) return;                              // no tocar otros componentes (filtro, header, etc.)
      
            if (t.closest(SEL_SWATCH) || t.closest(SEL_GRID_SWATCH)) {
              e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            }
          };
      
          // Capturamos hover; quitamos focusin para no romper el filtro en mobile
          document.addEventListener('mouseover', killHover, true);
          document.addEventListener('pointerenter', killHover, true);
          // document.addEventListener('focusin', killHover, true); // <- eliminado a propósito
        }
      
        /* ----------------------------------------------
         * 2) Swap por clic (sin navegar a la PDP)
         * ---------------------------------------------- */
        function getHandleFromUrl(url) {
          try {
            const u = new URL(url, location.origin);
            const parts = u.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
            const i = parts.indexOf('products');
            return i >= 0 ? parts[i + 1] : null;
          } catch { return null; }
        }
      
        function markActive(container, href) {
          const base = (href || '').split('?')[0];
          container.querySelectorAll(SEL_SWATCH).forEach((a) => {
            const link = (a.getAttribute('data-sibling-link') || a.getAttribute('href') || '').split('?')[0];
            a.classList.toggle('is-active', link === base);
          });
        }
      
        async function swapCardFromLink(swatchEl) {
          const card = swatchEl.closest(SEL_CARD);
          if (!card) return;
      
          const siblingLink = swatchEl.getAttribute('data-sibling-link') || swatchEl.getAttribute('href') || '';
          const handle = getHandleFromUrl(siblingLink);
          if (!handle) return;
      
          let requestUrl;
          try {
            const u = new URL(siblingLink, location.origin);
            u.searchParams.set('section_id', SECTION_ID);
            requestUrl = u.toString();
          } catch { return; }
      
          card.classList.add('is-loading');
          try {
            const res  = await fetch(requestUrl, { credentials: 'same-origin' });
            const html = await res.text();
            const doc  = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
            const newItem = doc.querySelector('product-item') || doc.querySelector('[data-grid-item]');
            if (!newItem) return;
      
            const doSwap = () => {
              if (window.theme?.htmlUpdate?.viewTransition) {
                window.theme.htmlUpdate.viewTransition(card, newItem, []);
              } else {
                card.replaceWith(newItem);
              }
              stripHoverFromSwatches(newItem);   // desactiva hover en la nueva card
              markActive(newItem, siblingLink);  // marca el swatch clickeado
            };
            requestAnimationFrame(doSwap);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('Swap falló', err);
          } finally {
            card.classList.remove('is-loading');
          }
        }
      
        // Intercepta clic en swatches de siblings para swap (y NO navegar)
        const interceptClick = async (e) => {
          const t = e.target;
          const el = (t instanceof Element) ? t : null;                  // <-- guard
          if (!el) return;
          const sw = el.closest(SEL_SWATCH);
          if (!sw) return;
      
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          await swapCardFromLink(sw);
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', interceptClick, true);
      
        // Inicial
        stripHoverFromSwatches(document);
      })();
      </script>
    <script>
      (() => {
      const qs = (root, sel) => root.querySelector(sel);
      const qsa = (root, sel) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(sel));

      function toInt(v, fallback = 1) {
        const n = parseInt(v, 10);
        return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : fallback;
      }
      function syncOneProductInfo(productInfoEl) {
        if (!productInfoEl) return;
        const formWrapper = qs(productInfoEl, "[data-form-wrapper]") || productInfoEl;
        const anyFormBoundInput = qs(formWrapper, "[form^='product-form-']");
        const productFormId = anyFormBoundInput ? anyFormBoundInput.getAttribute("form") : null;

        const submitItem = qs(formWrapper, ".product__submit__item") || qs(formWrapper, ".product__submit") || null;
        if (!submitItem) return;
        let hiddenQty = qs(submitItem, "input[type='hidden'][name='quantity'][data-quickadd-hidden-qty]");
        if (!hiddenQty) {
          hiddenQty = document.createElement("input");
          hiddenQty.type = "hidden";
          hiddenQty.name = "quantity";
          hiddenQty.value = "1";
          hiddenQty.setAttribute("data-quickadd-hidden-qty", "");
          if (productFormId) hiddenQty.setAttribute("form", productFormId);
          submitItem.appendChild(hiddenQty);
        } else {
          if (productFormId) hiddenQty.setAttribute("form", productFormId);
        }
        const qtyInput =
          qs(formWrapper, "input[data-quantity-input]") ||
          qs(formWrapper, "input[name='quantity'][type='number']") ||
          qs(formWrapper, "input[name='quantity']");

        const readQty = () => {
          if (!qtyInput) return 1;
          return toInt(qtyInput.value, 1);
        };

        const writeHidden = () => {
          const val = readQty();
          hiddenQty.value = String(val);
        };

        writeHidden();
        if (qtyInput) {
          qtyInput.addEventListener("input", writeHidden);
          qtyInput.addEventListener("change", writeHidden);
        }
        formWrapper.addEventListener(
          "click",
          (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest(
              ".quantity__button, [data-popout-option], [data-quantity-increment], [data-quantity-decrement]"
            );
            if (!btn) return;
            window.requestAnimationFrame(writeHidden);
          },
          { passive: true }
        );
        formWrapper.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
          if (e.target && (e.target.matches("select") || e.target.matches("input"))) {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(writeHidden);
          }
        });
        const mo = new MutationObserver(() => {
          const newQtyInput =
            qs(formWrapper, "input[data-quantity-input]") ||
            qs(formWrapper, "input[name='quantity'][type='number']") ||
            qs(formWrapper, "input[name='quantity']");
          if (newQtyInput && newQtyInput !== qtyInput) {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(writeHidden);
          }
        });
        mo.observe(formWrapper, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }

      function boot(root = document) {
        const productInfos = qsa(root, "product-info.product-upsell-info");
        productInfos.forEach(syncOneProductInfo);
      }

      if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => boot(document));
      } else {
        boot(document);
      }
      const globalMO = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        for (const m of mutations) {
          for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
            if (!(node instanceof Element)) continue;
            if (node.matches?.("product-info.product-upsell-info") || node.querySelector?.("product-info.product-upsell-info")) {
              boot(node);
            }
          }
        }
      });

      globalMO.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    })();
    </script>

<script>
  const saveRedirectLoaderData = (loaderData) => {
    if (!loaderData) return
    try {
      localStorage?.setItem('pinflagRedirectLoaderData', JSON.stringify(loaderData))
    } catch (e) {
      // El loader rico es solo cosmético: si falla (ej. cuota excedida), no debe bloquear el redirect al gateway
    }
  }

  const getRedirectLoaderData = () => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage?.getItem('pinflagRedirectLoaderData')
      if (!stored) return null
      return JSON.parse(stored)
    } catch (e) {
      return null
    }
  }

  const DEFAULT_TITLE = 'Sabías que?'
  const DEFAULT_BODY = 'La generación X compra más online que los Baby Boomers y Millennials'
  const DEFAULT_IMAGE_URL = 'https://did-you-know-image.s3.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com/woman-loader.png'

  const applyDidYouKnowDefaults = (loaderData) => ({
    ...loaderData,
    imageUrls: loaderData.imageUrls?.length ? loaderData.imageUrls : [DEFAULT_IMAGE_URL],
    title: loaderData.title || DEFAULT_TITLE,
    body: loaderData.body || DEFAULT_BODY,
    titleColor: loaderData.titleColor || '#000000',
    bodyColor: loaderData.bodyColor || '#000000'
  })

  const MODEL_CONTAINER_IDS = {
    split: 'pmp-v1-loader-split',
    centered: 'pmp-v1-loader-centered',
    bar: 'pmp-v1-loader-bar'
  }

  const populateLogo = (logoEl, logoUrl) => {
    if (!logoEl) return
    if (logoUrl) {
      logoEl.src = logoUrl
      logoEl.style.display = ''
    } else {
      logoEl.style.display = 'none'
    }
  }

  const populateText = (titleEl, bodyEl, loaderData) => {
    if (titleEl) {
      titleEl.textContent = loaderData.title || ''
      titleEl.style.color = loaderData.titleColor || ''
    }
    if (bodyEl) {
      bodyEl.textContent = loaderData.body || ''
      bodyEl.style.color = loaderData.bodyColor || ''
    }
  }

  const populateSpinner = (spinnerEl, color) => {
    if (!spinnerEl || !color) return
    spinnerEl.style.background = `conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0%, transparent 33%, ${color} 100%)`
  }

  const IMAGE_ROTATION_INTERVAL = 7000
  let imageRotationTimer = null

  const stopImageRotation = () => {
    if (!imageRotationTimer) return
    clearInterval(imageRotationTimer)
    imageRotationTimer = null
  }

  const populateSplitImages = (imageUrls) => {
    const imageContainer = document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-split-image')
    stopImageRotation()
    if (!imageContainer) return

    imageContainer.innerHTML = ''

    imageUrls.forEach((url, index) => {
      const layer = document.createElement('div')
      layer.className = 'pmp-v1-loader-split--image-layer'
      if (index === 0) layer.classList.add('pmp-v1-loader-split--image-layer--active')
      layer.style.backgroundImage = `url(${url})`
      imageContainer.appendChild(layer)
    })

    if (imageUrls.length <= 1) return

    let activeIndex = 0
    imageRotationTimer = setInterval(() => {
      const layers = imageContainer.querySelectorAll('.pmp-v1-loader-split--image-layer')
      layers[activeIndex]?.classList.remove('pmp-v1-loader-split--image-layer--active')
      activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % layers.length
      layers[activeIndex]?.classList.add('pmp-v1-loader-split--image-layer--active')
    }, IMAGE_ROTATION_INTERVAL)
  }

  const populateSplit = (loaderData) => {
    populateSplitImages((loaderData.imageUrls || []).filter(Boolean))

    populateLogo(document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-split-logo'), loaderData.logoUrl)
    populateText(
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-split-title'),
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-split-body'),
      loaderData
    )
  }

  const populateCentered = (loaderData) => {
    populateLogo(document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-centered-logo'), loaderData.logoUrl)
    populateText(
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-centered-title'),
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-centered-body'),
      loaderData
    )
    populateSpinner(document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-centered-spinner'), loaderData.secondaryColor)
  }

  const populateBar = (loaderData) => {
    const bannerEl = document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-banner')
    if (bannerEl && loaderData.backgroundColor) bannerEl.style.backgroundColor = loaderData.backgroundColor

    populateLogo(document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-logo'), loaderData.logoUrl)
    populateText(
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-title'),
      document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-body'),
      loaderData
    )
    populateSpinner(document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-spinner'), loaderData.secondaryColor)

    const loadingTextEl = document.getElementById('pmp-v1-loader-bar-loading-text')
    if (loadingTextEl && loaderData.secondaryColor) loadingTextEl.style.color = loaderData.secondaryColor
  }

  const POPULATE_BY_MODEL = {
    split: populateSplit,
    centered: populateCentered,
    bar: populateBar
  }

  const showRedirectSkeleton = () => {
    const loaderData = applyDidYouKnowDefaults(getRedirectLoaderData() || {})
    const modelDesign = loaderData.modelDesign || 'split'
    const containerId = MODEL_CONTAINER_IDS[modelDesign] || MODEL_CONTAINER_IDS.split
    const populateModel = POPULATE_BY_MODEL[modelDesign] || populateSplit

    populateModel(loaderData)
    document.getElementById(containerId)?.classList.add(`${containerId}--visible`)
  }

  const hideRedirectSkeleton = () => {
    stopImageRotation()
    document.getElementById('pmp-v1-redirect-skeleton')?.classList.remove('pmp-v1-redirect-skeleton--visible')
    Object.values(MODEL_CONTAINER_IDS).forEach((id) => {
      document.getElementById(id)?.classList.remove(`${id}--visible`)
    })
    localStorage?.removeItem('pinflagRedirectLoaderData')
  }
</script>
