<script>
  const pmpButtonIdv1 = 'pmp-v1-btn';
  const pmpIframeIdv1 = 'pinflag-pinmap-pro-v1';
  const pmpButtonIdv1Modal = 'pmp-v1-btn-modal';
  const pmpModalOverlayClassv1 = '.pmp-v1-modal--overlay';
  const pmpCloseButtonIdv1 = 'pmp-v1--close';
  const PINFLAG_SAFE_BUYNOW_ID = 'pinflag-buy-now-safe-btn'
  const PINFLAG_ADD_TO_CART_ERROR_ID = 'pinflag-add-to-cart-error'
  const OPUS_SHADOW_CONTAINER_ID = 'opus-shadow-container';
  const OPUS_CLOSE_BUTTON_SELECTOR = 'button.opus-drawer-container-close';
  const QUICK_BUY_SELECTOR = '[data-testid="Checkout-button"]'
  const NATIVE_CHECKOUT_SELECTORS = [
    '[name="checkout"]',
    QUICK_BUY_SELECTOR,
    '.AOV-CDMinimal__CheckoutButton',
    '.rebuy-cart__checkout-button'
  ].join(', ')

  const ADD_TO_CART_ERROR_FALLBACK = 'No pudimos agregar el producto al carro. Puede que esté agotado.'
  const MISSING_IDENTITY_REASON = 'no storefront session and no token configured'

  const LIMIT_GET_URL = 13;
  const LIMIT_CHECK = 8;
  const TIMEOUT_CHECK = 700;
  const PINFLAG_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 7000
  const CHECKOUT_CLICK_GRACE_MS = 3000
  const PINMAP_READY_RESCUE_MS = 2000
  const PINMAP_READY_RESCUE_ATTEMPTS = 5

  const COMPANY_API_BASE_URL = 'https://company-api-v2.pinflag.cl'
  const FALLBACK_CHECKOUT_URL = 'https://pinmap-one-click.pinflag.cl/'
  const CHECKOUT_3P_TYPE = 'checkout-3p'
  const ONE_CLICK_TYPE = 'one-click'
  const PINMAP_HOST_PATTERN = /^pinmap-[a-z0-9-]+\.pinflag\.cl$/
  let pinmapOrigin = null

  const getOrigin = (url) => {
    try {
      return new URL(url).origin
    } catch (error) {
      return null
    }
  }

  const parsePinmapUrl = (url) => {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(url)
      const isPinmapUrl = parsed.protocol === 'https:' &&
        PINMAP_HOST_PATTERN.test(parsed.hostname) &&
        !parsed.username && !parsed.password && !parsed.port &&
        parsed.pathname === '/' && !parsed.search && !parsed.hash
      return isPinmapUrl ? parsed : null
    } catch (error) {
      return null
    }
  }

  const resolveCheckout = (personalization) => {
    const checkoutUrl = parsePinmapUrl(personalization?.checkoutUrl)
    if (!checkoutUrl) return { type: ONE_CLICK_TYPE, url: FALLBACK_CHECKOUT_URL }
    return { type: personalization.selectedCheckout, url: checkoutUrl.href }
  }

  const isOneClickCheckout = (checkoutType) => checkoutType !== CHECKOUT_3P_TYPE

  const STOREFRONT_SESSION_URL = '/apps/pinflag/session'
  const PERSONALIZATION_URL = '/apps/pinflag/personalization'
  const ORDER_STATUS_URL_ENDPOINT = '/apps/pinflag/order-status-url'
  const ORDER_STATUS_ENDPOINT = '/apps/pinflag/order-status'
  const INVENTORY_LOCATIONS_URL = '/apps/pinflag/inventory-locations'
  const TRACKING_PINMAP_URL = '/apps/pinflag/tracking/pinmap'
  const STOREFRONT_SESSION_QUERY = '?session=storefront'
  const STOREFRONT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY = 'pinflagStorefrontSession'
  const STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STORAGE_KEY = 'pinflagStorefrontSessionDisabled'
  const STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STATUS = 403
  const SESSION_RENEWAL_RATIO = 0.8
  const MIN_SESSION_RENEWAL_SECONDS = 30
  const SESSION_REUSE_MARGIN_MS = 60 * 1000
  const SESSION_DISABLED_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
  const SESSION_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000

  const PERSONALIZATION_STORAGE_KEY = 'pinflagPersonalization'
  const PERSONALIZATION_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000

  const NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY = 'nativeTrackingData'

  const LORENZODIPONTTI_HOST = 'lorenzodipontti'
  const TOYNG_HOST = 'toyng'
  const BUBBA_HOST = 'bubba'
  const MIPLACARD_HOST = 'miplacard'
  const LOCCITANE_HOST = 'loccitane'
  const FORUS_HOSTS = ['parfois', 'merrell', 'azaleia', 'risoluciones', 'underarmour', 'columbia', 'caterpillar', 'vans', 'rkflife', 'hushpuppies', LOCCITANE_HOST, 'viste']
  const HOSTS_WITH_BUY_NOW_PATCH = [TOYNG_HOST, BUBBA_HOST, MIPLACARD_HOST];
  const HOSTS_WITH_DAWN_PATCH = [BUBBA_HOST];
  const CLASSES_TO_STRIP_BY_HOST = { [LOCCITANE_HOST]: ['cart__checkout-button'] };

  let storefrontSession = null
  let sessionRenewalTimeoutId = null
  let isIframeUsingSession = false
  let isIframeIdentified = false
  let isNativeCheckoutForced = false
  let resolveSessionAck
  const sessionAckPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { resolveSessionAck = resolve })
  let companyInfoData = null
  const checkoutReadyListeners = []
  const onCheckoutReady = (listener) => checkoutReadyListeners.push(listener)
  const notifyCheckoutReady = () => checkoutReadyListeners.forEach((listener) => listener())

  const isBuyNowPatchHost = () => HOSTS_WITH_BUY_NOW_PATCH.some((host) => window.location.host.includes(host));
  const isDawnPatchHost = () => HOSTS_WITH_DAWN_PATCH.some((host) => window.location.host.includes(host));
  const getClassesToStripForHost = () => {
    const matchedHost = Object.keys(CLASSES_TO_STRIP_BY_HOST).find((host) => window.location.host.includes(host));
    return matchedHost ? CLASSES_TO_STRIP_BY_HOST[matchedHost] : [];
  };

  const autoReplaceButtons = 'true' === 'true';

  const removeApiKeyFromNativeTrackingData = () => {
    try {
      const storedTrackingData = localStorage.getItem(NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY)
      if (!storedTrackingData) return

      let trackingData
      try {
        trackingData = JSON.parse(storedTrackingData)
      } catch {
        localStorage.removeItem(NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY)
        return
      }

      if (!trackingData?.pinflagApiKey) return

      delete trackingData.pinflagApiKey
      localStorage.setItem(NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(trackingData))
    } catch {
      // localStorage throws when blocked (e.g. Safari private mode); there is nothing to clean up then
    }
  }

  removeApiKeyFromNativeTrackingData()

  localStorage?.setItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded', 'not loaded');
  localStorage?.setItem('availableCheckoutPinmap', 'loading');

  const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT_PX = 750;

  const clearInlineStyle = (el, properties) => {
    if (!el) return;
    properties.forEach((property) => { el.style[property] = ''; });
  };

  const applyRealMobileViewportBox = () => {
    const overlay = document.querySelector(pmpModalOverlayClassv1);
    const content = document.querySelector('.pmp-v1-modal--content');

    if (window.innerWidth > MOBILE_BREAKPOINT_PX) {
      clearInlineStyle(overlay, ['height', 'width', 'top', 'left']);
      clearInlineStyle(content, ['height']);
      return;
    }

    const visualViewport = window.visualViewport;
    const heightPx = `${visualViewport ? visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight}px`;
    const widthPx = visualViewport ? `${visualViewport.width}px` : '100%';
    const topPx = `${visualViewport ? visualViewport.offsetTop : 0}px`;
    const leftPx = `${visualViewport ? visualViewport.offsetLeft : 0}px`;

    if (overlay) {
      overlay.style.height = heightPx;
      overlay.style.width = widthPx;
      overlay.style.top = topPx;
      overlay.style.left = leftPx;
    }
    if (content) content.style.height = heightPx;
  };

  applyRealMobileViewportBox();
  window.addEventListener('resize', applyRealMobileViewportBox);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', applyRealMobileViewportBox);
  if (window.visualViewport) {
    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', applyRealMobileViewportBox);
    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', applyRealMobileViewportBox);
  }

  let pinflagLockedScrollY = 0;

  const lockBodyScroll = (body) => {
    pinflagLockedScrollY = window.scrollY;
    body.style.position = 'fixed';
    body.style.top = `-${pinflagLockedScrollY}px`;
    body.style.width = '100%';
    body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  };

  const unlockBodyScroll = (body) => {
    body.style.position = '';
    body.style.top = '';
    body.style.width = '';
    body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    window.scrollTo(0, pinflagLockedScrollY);
  };

  const loadIframeWithUrl = (personalization) => {
    const { type: checkoutType, url: baseUrl } = resolveCheckout(personalization)
    pinmapOrigin = getOrigin(baseUrl)
    isIframeUsingSession = LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length === 0 && Boolean(storefrontSession)
    const iframeUrl = isIframeUsingSession
      ? baseUrl + STOREFRONT_SESSION_QUERY
      : baseUrl + '?token='
    const iframe = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
    if (iframe) {
      if (isIframeUsingSession) iframe.addEventListener('load', handleSessionIframeLoad, { once: true })
      iframe.src = iframeUrl
      scheduleIframeReadyRescue()
    }
    const modalContent = document.querySelector('.pmp-v1-modal--content')
    if (modalContent) {
      modalContent.classList.toggle('pmp-v1-modal--content--one-click', isOneClickCheckout(checkoutType))
    }
    toggleCloseButton(checkoutType)
  }

  const toggleCloseButton = (checkoutType) => {
    const closeButton = document.getElementById(pmpCloseButtonIdv1)
    const attribution = document.querySelector('.pinflag-attribution')
    if (isOneClickCheckout(checkoutType)) {
      if (closeButton) closeButton.style.display = 'none'
      if (attribution) attribution.style.display = 'none'
    } else {
      if (closeButton) closeButton.style.display = 'block'
      if (attribution) attribution.style.display = 'block'
    }
  }

  const fetchWithTimeout = async (url, options = {}) => {
    const abortController = new AbortController()
    const abortTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => abortController.abort(), PINFLAG_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)

    try {
      return await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: abortController.signal })
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(abortTimeoutId)
    }
  }

  const readSessionStorageJson = (key) => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key) || 'null')
    } catch {
      return null
    }
  }

  const writeSessionStorageJson = (key, value) => {
    try {
      if (value) sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
      else sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
    } catch {
      // sessionStorage throws when blocked (e.g. Safari private mode); the cache is best-effort
    }
  }

  const fetchStorefrontSession = async () => {
    if (LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length > 0) return null

    try {
      const response = await fetchWithTimeout(STOREFRONT_SESSION_URL)

      if (response.status === STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STATUS) {
        writeSessionStorageJson(STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STORAGE_KEY, { cachedAt: Date.now() })
        return null
      }

      if (!response.ok) return null

      const session = await response.json()

      if (!session || !session.token) return null

      writeSessionStorageJson(STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STORAGE_KEY, null)

      return { ...session, expiresAt: Date.now() + session.expiresIn * 1000 }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Pinflag: could not fetch the storefront session', error)
      return null
    }
  }

  const readCachedStorefrontSession = () => {
    const cachedSession = readSessionStorageJson(STOREFRONT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY)

    const isReusable = cachedSession && cachedSession.token &&
      cachedSession.expiresAt - Date.now() > SESSION_REUSE_MARGIN_MS

    return isReusable ? cachedSession : null
  }

  const isStorefrontSessionKnownDisabled = () => {
    const disabledMarker = readSessionStorageJson(STOREFRONT_SESSION_DISABLED_STORAGE_KEY)

    return Boolean(disabledMarker) &&
      Date.now() - disabledMarker.cachedAt < SESSION_DISABLED_CACHE_TTL_MS
  }

  const LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY = ''

  const hasCompanyIdentity = () => Boolean(storefrontSession) || LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length > 0

  const getPinflagAuthHeaders = () => storefrontSession
    ? { 'x-pinflag-session': storefrontSession.token }
    : { 'x-api-key': LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY }

  const getPinflagIdentity = () => storefrontSession
    ? storefrontSession.token
    : LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY

  const getIframeIdentity = () => isIframeUsingSession && storefrontSession
    ? storefrontSession.token
    : LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY

  const sendSessionToIframe = () => {
    const iframe = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
    if (!iframe || !iframe.contentWindow || !storefrontSession || !isIframeUsingSession) return

    if (!pinmapOrigin || getOrigin(iframe.src) !== pinmapOrigin) return

    iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(
      { type: 'receive-session', token: storefrontSession.token, shop: storefrontSession.shop },
      pinmapOrigin
    )
  }

  const handleSessionIframeLoad = () => {
    sendSessionToIframe()
    setTimeout(() => resolveSessionAck(false), SESSION_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS)
  }

  const confirmIframeSession = () => {
    if (isIframeUsingSession) resolveSessionAck(true)
  }

  const canIframeIdentifyCompany = async () => {
    if (LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length > 0) return true

    return isIframeUsingSession && sessionAckPromise
  }

  const scheduleSessionRenewal = () => {
    if (sessionRenewalTimeoutId) clearTimeout(sessionRenewalTimeoutId)
    if (!storefrontSession || !Number.isFinite(storefrontSession.expiresAt)) return

    const remainingSeconds = (storefrontSession.expiresAt - Date.now()) / 1000
    const delaySeconds = Math.max(
      remainingSeconds * SESSION_RENEWAL_RATIO,
      MIN_SESSION_RENEWAL_SECONDS
    )
    sessionRenewalTimeoutId = setTimeout(renewStorefrontSession, delaySeconds * 1000)
  }

  const adoptStorefrontSession = (session) => {
    storefrontSession = session
    writeSessionStorageJson(STOREFRONT_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY, session)
    if (session) scheduleSessionRenewal()
    else clearTimeout(sessionRenewalTimeoutId)
  }

  const renewStorefrontSession = async () => {
    const session = await fetchStorefrontSession()
    if (!session) return null

    adoptStorefrontSession(session)
    sendSessionToIframe()

    return session
  }

  const isTrustedPinmapMessage = (event) => {
    if (!pinmapOrigin || event.origin !== pinmapOrigin) return false
    const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
    return Boolean(pinmap) && event.source === pinmap.contentWindow
  }

  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (!isTrustedPinmapMessage(event)) return
    if (!event.data || event.data.type !== 'request-session-refresh') return

    if (!event.data.hasSession && storefrontSession) {
      sendSessionToIframe()
      return
    }

    renewStorefrontSession()
  })

  const requestCompanyPersonalization = async (headers) => {
    const response = await fetchWithTimeout(
      PERSONALIZATION_URL,
      { headers }
    )

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = new Error(`company personalization responded ${response.status}`)
      error.status = response.status
      throw error
    }

    return response.json()
  }

  const cachedStorefrontSession = readCachedStorefrontSession()

  const loadStorefrontSession = async () => {
    if (LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length > 0) return null
    if (cachedStorefrontSession) return cachedStorefrontSession
    if (isStorefrontSessionKnownDisabled()) return null

    return fetchStorefrontSession()
  }

  const sessionPromise = loadStorefrontSession().then((session) => {
    adoptStorefrontSession(session)

    return session
  })

  const requestSessionPersonalization = async () => {
    await sessionPromise

    try {
      return await requestCompanyPersonalization(getPinflagAuthHeaders())
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.status !== 401 || !cachedStorefrontSession) throw error

      const renewedSession = await fetchStorefrontSession()
      adoptStorefrontSession(renewedSession)

      if (!renewedSession) throw error

      return requestCompanyPersonalization(getPinflagAuthHeaders())
    }
  }

  const fetchCompanyPersonalization = () => LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length > 0
    ? requestCompanyPersonalization({ 'x-api-key': LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY })
    : requestSessionPersonalization()

  const loadCompanyPersonalization = async () => {
    const cachedPersonalization = readSessionStorageJson(PERSONALIZATION_STORAGE_KEY)
    const isCachedPersonalizationFresh = cachedPersonalization &&
      cachedPersonalization.data && 'checkoutUrl' in cachedPersonalization.data &&
      Date.now() - cachedPersonalization.cachedAt < PERSONALIZATION_CACHE_TTL_MS

    if (isCachedPersonalizationFresh) return cachedPersonalization.data

    const personalization = await fetchCompanyPersonalization()
    writeSessionStorageJson(PERSONALIZATION_STORAGE_KEY, { data: personalization, cachedAt: Date.now() })

    return personalization
  }

  const personalizationPromise = loadCompanyPersonalization().catch((error) => {
    console.error('Error al obtener información de la compañía:', error)

    return null
  })

  const leaveNativeCheckout = (reason) => {
    isNativeCheckoutForced = true
    console.error(`Pinflag: ${reason}, leaving native checkout`)
  }

  const getCompanyInfoAndLoadIframe = async () => {
    if (LEGACY_THEME_API_KEY.length === 0) await sessionPromise

    if (!hasCompanyIdentity()) {
      leaveNativeCheckout(MISSING_IDENTITY_REASON)
      return
    }

    companyInfoData = await personalizationPromise

    if (!hasCompanyIdentity()) {
      leaveNativeCheckout(MISSING_IDENTITY_REASON)
      return
    }

    loadIframeWithUrl(companyInfoData)
    isIframeIdentified = await canIframeIdentifyCompany()

    if (!isIframeIdentified) {
      leaveNativeCheckout('pinmap did not confirm the storefront session in time')
      return
    }

    notifyCheckoutReady()
  }

  const domReadyPromise = document.readyState === 'loading'
    ? new Promise((resolve) => document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve, { once: true }))
    : Promise.resolve()

  const bootstrapPromise = domReadyPromise
    .then(getCompanyInfoAndLoadIframe)
    .catch((error) => console.error('Pinflag: checkout bootstrap failed', error))

  let resolveCheckoutOpener
  const checkoutOpenerPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { resolveCheckoutOpener = resolve })
  const registerCheckoutOpener = (opener) => resolveCheckoutOpener(opener)

  const GRACE_EXPIRED = Symbol('checkout grace expired')
  const releasedCheckoutButtons = new WeakSet()

  const raceCheckoutGrace = (promise) => Promise.race([
    promise,
    new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(GRACE_EXPIRED), CHECKOUT_CLICK_GRACE_MS))
  ])

  if (autoReplaceButtons) {
    document.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
      const nativeButton = event.target?.closest?.(NATIVE_CHECKOUT_SELECTORS)

      if (!nativeButton || nativeButton.id === pmpButtonIdv1) return
      if (releasedCheckoutButtons.has(nativeButton)) return

      const buttonParent = nativeButton.parentNode

      event.preventDefault()
      event.stopPropagation()

      const checkoutOpener = await raceCheckoutGrace(
        Promise.all([bootstrapPromise, checkoutOpenerPromise]).then(([, opener]) => opener)
      )

      if (checkoutOpener === GRACE_EXPIRED || isNativeCheckoutForced || !hasCompanyIdentity()) {
        releasedCheckoutButtons.add(nativeButton)

        const liveButton = nativeButton.isConnected
          ? nativeButton
          : buttonParent?.querySelector(`#${pmpButtonIdv1}`)

        liveButton?.click()

        return
      }

      checkoutOpener(nativeButton.matches(QUICK_BUY_SELECTOR))
    }, true)
  }


  let pinmapReadyRescueId = null

  function scheduleIframeReadyRescue(attemptsLeft = PINMAP_READY_RESCUE_ATTEMPTS) {
    if (attemptsLeft <= 0) return
    if (localStorage?.getItem('availableCheckoutPinmap') !== 'loading') return

    pinmapReadyRescueId = setTimeout(() => {
      const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1);
      pinmap?.contentWindow?.postMessage(
        {
          type: 'is-ready',
          origin: window.location.host,
          message: true,
          cms: 'shopify',
        },
        '*'
      );
      scheduleIframeReadyRescue(attemptsLeft - 1);
    }, PINMAP_READY_RESCUE_MS);
  }

  function saveCookie(cookie) {
    const value = cookie.trim().split('=')[1];
    localStorage.setItem('cartSession', value);
  }

  function writeCartCookie() {
    if (localStorage.getItem('cartSession')) {
      document.cookie = 'cart=' + localStorage.getItem('cartSession');
      localStorage.removeItem('cartSession');
      window.location.reload();
    }
  }

  function deleteCartCookies() {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    const checkoutSessionCookies = cookies.filter((cookie) => cookie.includes('cart='));
    for (let i = 0; i < checkoutSessionCookies.length; i++) {
      const cookie = checkoutSessionCookies[i];
      saveCookie(cookie);
      const eqPos = cookie.indexOf('=');
      const name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos) : cookie;
      document.cookie = name + '=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT';
    }
  }

  function deleteAllCookiesScrapper() {
    var cookies = document.cookie.split(';');

    for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
      var cookie = cookies[i];
      var eqPos = cookie.indexOf('=');
      var name = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos) : cookie;
      var path = location.pathname.substring(0, location.pathname.lastIndexOf('/'));
      document.cookie = name + '=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; domain=' + document.domain + '; path=/';
    }
  }

  function deleteHttpOnlyCookie(name) {
    document.cookie = name + '=; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT; path=/';
    document.cookie = name + '=deleted; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT; path=/; domain=' + document.domain + ';';
    document.cookie =
      name + '=deleted; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT; path=/; domain=.' + document.domain + ';';
  }

  function deleteCookie(name) {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');

    for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
      const cookie = cookies[i];
      const eqPos = cookie.indexOf('=');
      const cookieName = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos).trim() : cookie;
      if (cookieName.includes(name)) {
        document.cookie =
          cookieName + '=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; domain=' + document.domain + '; path=/';
        document.cookie =
          cookieName + '=expires; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT; path=/; domain=.' + document.domain + ';';
      }
    }
  }

  const doesHttpOnlyCookieExist = (cookieName) => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setTime(d.getTime() + 1000);
    const expires = 'expires=' + d.toUTCString();

    document.cookie = cookieName + '=new_value;path=/;' + expires;
    return document.cookie.indexOf(cookieName + '=') == -1;
  };

  const validateCartCookie = () => {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    const cartCookie = cookies.filter((cookie) => cookie.includes('cart='))[0];
    if (cartCookie) {
      const cartValue = cartCookie.split('=')[1];
      if (doesHttpOnlyCookieExist('checkout_session_token__cn__' + cartValue)) {
        document.cookie = 'cart=';
        window.location.reload();
      }
    }
  };

      const copyComputedStyles = (sourceElement, targetElement) => {
        const computedStyles = getComputedStyle(sourceElement);

        const propertiesToCopy = [
          'display', 'width', 'min-width', 'max-width',
          'padding-top','padding-right','padding-bottom','padding-left',
          'margin-top','margin-right','margin-bottom','margin-left',
          'border-top-width','border-right-width','border-bottom-width','border-left-width',
          'border-top-style','border-right-style','border-bottom-style','border-left-style',
          'border-top-color','border-right-color','border-bottom-color','border-left-color',
          'border-radius',
          'background-color','background-image',
          'color',
          'font-family','font-size','font-weight','line-height','letter-spacing','text-transform',
          'text-align',
          'box-shadow',
          'cursor',
          'height','min-height'
        ];

        propertiesToCopy.forEach((propertyName) => {
          const propertyValue = computedStyles.getPropertyValue(propertyName);
          const propertyPriority = computedStyles.getPropertyPriority(propertyName);

          if (propertyValue) {
            targetElement.style.setProperty(propertyName, propertyValue, propertyPriority);
          }

      let cartWriteChain = Promise.resolve()
      const enqueueCartWrite = (task) => {
        const result = cartWriteChain.then(() => task())
        cartWriteChain = result.then(() => {}, () => {})
        return result
      }

      const expectedPropsByVariant = new Map()
      const recordExpectedProps = (variantId, props) => {
        const variantKey = String(variantId)
        const current = expectedPropsByVariant.get(variantKey) || {}
        const next = { ...current }
        Object.keys(props || {}).forEach((key) => {
          const value = props[key]
          if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) {
            delete next[key]
          } else {
            next[key] = value
          }
        })
        expectedPropsByVariant.set(variantKey, next)
      }
      const removeExpectedProp = (variantId, propName) => {
        const variantKey = String(variantId)
        const current = expectedPropsByVariant.get(variantKey)
        if (!current) return
        delete current[propName]
        expectedPropsByVariant.set(variantKey, current)
      }

      function redirectToCheckoutScrapper(checkoutData) {
        let url;
        let cookies;
        if (typeof checkoutData === 'object') {
          url = checkoutData.permalink;
          deleteCookie('checkout_session_token');
          deleteCookie('checkout_session_lookup');
          deleteCookie('queue_token');

          cookies = checkoutData.cookies;
          const pinflagCustomerCookies = [checkoutData.email];
          cookies.map((cookie) => {
            var eqPos = cookie.indexOf('=');
            var cookieName = eqPos > -1 ? cookie.substr(0, eqPos) : cookie;
            if (!document.cookie.includes(`${cookieName}=`) && !cookieName.includes('cart')) {
              if (cookie.includes('httpOnly')) {
                cookie = cookie.slice(0, -10);
              }
              if (url.includes('thank_you')) {
                document.cookie = cookie;
              } else {
                pinflagCustomerCookies.push(cookie);
              }
            }
          });
          localStorage.setItem('pinflagCustomer', pinflagCustomerCookies.join('--pinflag--'));
        } else {
          url = checkoutData;
        }
        if (!isSafeRedirectUrl(url)) return;
        window.location.replace(url);
      }

      const checkMultiOrigin = async (cart) => {
        try {
          const items = cart.items.map(item => ({ variantId: item.variant_id, sku: item.sku }))
          const response = await axios.post(
            INVENTORY_LOCATIONS_URL,
            {
              variantIds: items.map(item => item.variantId),
              cartId: cart.token,
              items,
              cartTotalPrice: cart.total_price / 100,
              cartTotalWeight: Math.ceil(cart.total_weight / 1000),
            },
            { headers: getPinflagAuthHeaders() }
          )
          return response.data
        } catch (error) {
          console.log('error checking multi-origin', error)
          return { isMultiOrigin: false, items: {} }
        }
      }

      const setCartItemsProperties = async (cartItems, extraProperties) => {
        for (let i = 0; i < cartItems.length; i++) {
          const item = cartItems[i]
          const prevProperties = item.properties || {}
          const properties = {
            ...prevProperties,
            ...extraProperties(item),
          }
          await axios.post(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart/change.js', {
            line: i + 1,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            properties,
          })
        }
        await axios.post(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart/update.js', {})
      }

      const getMultiOriginData = async (cart) => {
        if (!FORUS_HOSTS.some(host => window.location.host.includes(host))) return null
        try {
          const multiOriginData = await checkMultiOrigin(cart)
          return multiOriginData.isMultiOrigin ? multiOriginData : null
        } catch (error) {
          console.log('error checking multi-origin', error)
          return null
        }
      }

      const buildMultiOriginProperties = (cart, multiOriginData) => {
        if (!multiOriginData) return null
        const cartTotalWeight = Math.ceil(cart.total_weight / 1000)
        const cartTotalPrice = cart.total_price / 100
        return cart.items.map(item => ({
          variant_id: item.variant_id,
          properties: {
            _cart_total_price: cartTotalPrice,
            _cart_total_weight: cartTotalWeight,
            _multi_origin: multiOriginData.items?.[item.variant_id] || 'calculate',
          }
        }))
      }

      const STOCK_ORIGIN_PROPERTY = '_stock_origin'

      const formatStockOriginSection = (qty, warehouse) => (
        warehouse
          ? { qty, storeId: warehouse.storeId, shopifyId: warehouse.shopifyId }
          : { qty }
      )

      const buildStockOriginProperty = (sku, storeItems, cdItems, storeWarehouse, cdWarehouse) => {
        const storeQty = storeItems.find(s => s.sku === sku)?.quantity || 0
        const cdQty = cdItems.find(s => s.sku === sku)?.quantity || 0
        const origin = {}
        if (storeQty > 0) origin.store = formatStockOriginSection(storeQty, storeWarehouse)
        if (cdQty > 0) origin.cd = formatStockOriginSection(cdQty, cdWarehouse)
        return Object.keys(origin).length ? JSON.stringify(origin) : ''
      }

      const buildStockOriginIframeUpdate = (cartItems, valueByItem) => (
        cartItems.map(item => ({
          variant_id: item.variant_id,
          properties: { [STOCK_ORIGIN_PROPERTY]: valueByItem.get(item) }
        }))
      )

      const setStockOriginProperties = (message) => enqueueCartWrite(async () => {
        const { storeItems = [], cdItems = [], storeWarehouse, cdWarehouse } = message || {}
        try {
          const cart = (await getCartData()).data
          const newValueByItem = new Map(
            cart.items.map(item => [
              item,
              buildStockOriginProperty(item.sku, storeItems, cdItems, storeWarehouse, cdWarehouse)
            ])
          )
          cart.items.forEach(item => recordExpectedProps(item.variant_id, {
            [STOCK_ORIGIN_PROPERTY]: newValueByItem.get(item)
          }))
          const needsUpdate = cart.items.some(
            item => newValueByItem.get(item) !== (item.properties?.[STOCK_ORIGIN_PROPERTY] || '')
          )
          if (!needsUpdate) return

          await setCartItemsProperties(cart.items, (item) => ({
            [STOCK_ORIGIN_PROPERTY]: newValueByItem.get(item)
          }))
          sendCartItemsProperties(buildStockOriginIframeUpdate(cart.items, newValueByItem))
        } catch (error) {
          console.log('error setting stock origin properties', error)
        }
      })

      const sendCartItemsProperties = (itemsProperties) => {
        const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
        if (!pinmap?.contentWindow) return
        pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage({
          type: 'update-cart-items-properties',
          origin: window.location.host,
          message: { itemsProperties },
          cms: 'shopify',
        }, '*')
      }

      const processMultiOriginInBackground = async (cart) => {
        const multiOriginData = await getMultiOriginData(cart)
        const itemsProperties = buildMultiOriginProperties(cart, multiOriginData)
        if (itemsProperties) {
          sendCartItemsProperties(itemsProperties)
        }
      }

      const redirectToCheckout = async (urlShopify) => {
        await removeNoteAttributesPixelPinflag()
        if (urlShopify.email) {
          redirectToCheckoutScrapper(urlShopify);
          return;
        }
        const correctUrl = new URL(urlShopify);
        correctUrl.hostname = window.location.host;
        const url = correctUrl.href;

        let limit = 0;
        const fetchUrl = () => {
          fetch(url)
            .then((res) => res.text())
            .then((res) => {
              if (res.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>')) {
                window.location.replace(url);
                clearInterval(interval);
              }
              if (limit === LIMIT_GET_URL) {
                window.location.replace('/checkout');
                clearInterval(interval);
              }
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              window.location.replace('/checkout');
              console.error(err);
            });
          limit += 1;
        };
        const interval = setInterval(fetchUrl, 1500);
        fetchUrl();
      };

      const removeNoteAttributesPixelPinflag = async () => {
        try {
          const response = await getCartData()
          const cartAttributes = response.data.attributes || {}
          if (cartAttributes.pixelPinflag) {
            cartAttributes.pixelPinflag = ''
          }
          await axios.post(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart/update.js', {
            attributes: cartAttributes
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('error', error)
        }
      }

      function iframeLoaded(isCorrect, nativeTrackingData) {
        localStorage?.setItem('availableCheckoutPinmap', isCorrect);
        if (pinmapReadyRescueId) clearTimeout(pinmapReadyRescueId);

        if (nativeTrackingData) {
          const { companyName, cms } = nativeTrackingData
          localStorage?.setItem(NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ companyName, cms }))
        }

        const isLorenzodiponttiLoggedIn = window.location.host.includes(LORENZODIPONTTI_HOST) && loggedIn

        if (!isCorrect || isLorenzodiponttiLoggedIn) {
          localStorage?.setItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded', 'not loaded');
        } else {
          localStorage?.setItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded', 'loaded');
        }

        const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
        const pinflagApiKey = getIframeIdentity()

        if (companyInfoData) {
          sendCompanyInfoToIframe()
        } else {
          if (pinmap && pinmap.contentWindow) {
            pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage({
              type: 'request-company-info',
              origin: window.location.host,
              pinflagApiKey: pinflagApiKey,
              message: true,
              cms: 'shopify'
            }, '*')
          }

          setTimeout(() => {
            if (companyInfoData) {
              sendCompanyInfoToIframe()
            }
          }, 1000)
        }
      }

      function removeIframe() {
        localStorage?.setItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded', 'not loaded');
        window.location.replace('/checkout');
      }

      function redirectToHome() {
        window.location.replace('/');
      }

      function redirectToCart() {
        window.location.replace('/cart');
      }

      // Author: Rosita :)
      // Se implementa una función para cerrar el pinmap
      function closePinmap() {
        document.querySelector(pmpModalOverlayClassv1).classList.remove('overlay--active');
        unlockBodyScroll(document.querySelector('body'));
        checkAbandonedCheckoutCookie();
      }

      // author: rosita
      // se hace update de las cantidades de lo productos del cart
      const updateCart = async (data) => {
        const { key, quantity } = data;
        axios
          .post(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart/change.js', {
            id: key.toString(),
            quantity,
          })
          .then((res) => {
            sendUpdatedCartInfo(res.data, key);
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.log('error', err);
            sendUpdatedCartInfo(err.response.data, key);
          });
      };

      const sendUpdatedCartInfo = (data, key) => {
        const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1);
        if (data.status) {
          pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage(
            {
              type: 'update-info-cart',
              origin: window.location.host,
              message: { error: data.message },
              cms: 'shopify',
            },
            '*'
          );
        } else {
          pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage(
            {
              type: 'update-info-cart',
              origin: window.location.host,
              message: data,
              cms: 'shopify',
            },
            '*'
          );
        }
      };

      const setABTestCookie = () => {
        document.cookie = 'checkout_origin=pinmap pro;path=/';
      };

      const emptyCart = async () => {
        try {
          await axios.post(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart/clear.js', {})
          deleteHttpOnlyCookie('cart')
        } catch (err) {
          console.log('error', err)
        }
      }

      function setCookie(name, value) {
        let expires = "";
        let date = new Date();
        date.setTime(date.getTime() + (60 * 60 * 1000)); // 1 hour
        expires = "; expires=" + date.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + expires + "; path=/";
      }

      function encodePendingStateIds(stateIds) {
        return btoa(JSON.stringify(stateIds))
      }

      function decodePendingStateIds(encoded) {
        if (!encoded) return []
        try {
          return JSON.parse(atob(encoded))
        } catch (e) {
          return []
        }
      }

      function handleRequestCompanyInfo(eventMessage) {
        const pinflagApiKey = getIframeIdentity()
        if (eventMessage.pinflagApiKey === pinflagApiKey && companyInfoData) {
          const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
          if (pinmap && pinmap.contentWindow) {
            const companyInfoToSend = prepareCompanyInfo()
            if (companyInfoToSend) {
              pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage({
                type: 'response-company-info',
                origin: window.location.host,
                pinflagApiKey: pinflagApiKey,
                message: companyInfoToSend,
                cms: 'shopify'
              }, '*')
            }
          }
        }
      }

      function handleResponseCompanyInfo(eventMessage) {
        const pinflagApiKey = getIframeIdentity()
        if (eventMessage?.pinflagApiKey === pinflagApiKey && eventMessage.message && !companyInfoData) {
          const originalFormat = transformToOriginalFormat(eventMessage.message)
          companyInfoData = originalFormat
          sendCompanyInfoToIframe()
        }
      }

      const isSafeRedirectUrl = (url) => {
        try {
          const protocol = new URL(url, window.location.origin).protocol
          return protocol === 'https:' || protocol === 'http:'
        } catch (error) {
          return false
        }
      }

      const redirectToUrl = ({ url, stateId, loaderData }) => {
        if (!isSafeRedirectUrl(url)) return
        const pendingStateIds = decodePendingStateIds(getCookie('pinflagPaymentRedirect'))
        pendingStateIds.push(stateId)
        setCookie('pinflagPaymentRedirect', JSON.stringify(encodePendingStateIds(pendingStateIds)))
        saveRedirectLoaderData(loaderData)
        window.location.href = url
      }

      function messageHandler(eventMessage) {
        if (eventMessage.type === 'request-company-info') {
          return handleRequestCompanyInfo(eventMessage);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'response-company-info') {
          return handleResponseCompanyInfo(eventMessage);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'receive-checkout-id') {
          return setPinmapProCheckoutId(eventMessage.message);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'redirect-to-checkout') {
          return redirectToCheckout(eventMessage.message);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'iframe-loaded') {
          return iframeLoaded(eventMessage.message, eventMessage.extraData);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'session-received') {
          return confirmIframeSession();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'remove-iframe') {
          return removeIframe();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'redirect-to-home') {
          return redirectToHome();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'redirect-to-cart') {
          return redirectToCart();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'ga-opened-pinmap') {
          return pushOpenedPinmap();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'ga-event-completed-user-info') {
          return pushFormEvent();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'ga-event-go-payment') {
          setABTestCookie();
          return pushPayEvent();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'ga-event-completed-payment_selection') {
          return pushCompletedPaySelectionEvent();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'close-iframe') {
          return closePinmap();
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'update-cart') {
          return updateCart(eventMessage.message);
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'payment-success') {
          return emptyCart()
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'gateway-redirect') {
          return redirectToUrl(eventMessage.message)
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'set-stock-origin-properties') {
          return setStockOriginProperties(eventMessage.message)
        }
        if (eventMessage.type === 'request-parent-url') {
          const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)
          pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage({
            type: "receive-parent-url",
            origin: window.location.host,
            message: { currentUrl: window.location.host },
            cms: 'shopify'
          }, '*')
        }
      }

      const updateHeaderSection = (headerContent) => {
        // HeaderContent should be an html string
        try {
          if (!headerContent) {
            // Find #CartCount and update it
            const cartCount = document.getElementById('CartCount');
            const currentCartCount = parseInt(cartCount.innerHTML);
            cartCount.innerHTML = currentCartCount + 1;
            return;
          }
          // Convert the string to a DOM element
          const temp = document.createElement('div');
          temp.innerHTML = headerContent;
          // Inside this element, find the header section
          const newHeader = temp.querySelector('header');
          // Replace the header section with the new one (find the html and replace it)
          const headerSelector = newHeader.id
            ? `#${newHeader.id}`
            : newHeader.class
            ? `.${newHeader.class}`.replace(' ', '.')
            : 'header';
          let originalHeader = document.querySelector(headerSelector);
          // If is more than one header, get the first one
          if (originalHeader && originalHeader.length > 1) {
            originalHeader = originalHeader[0];
          }
          if (originalHeader) {
            originalHeader.innerHTML = newHeader.innerHTML;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.log('No fue posible actualizar el header:', error)
        }
      };

      const getCookies = () => {
        const cookies = document.cookie
          .split(';')
          .filter((cookie) => !cookie.includes('checkout') && !cookie.includes('queue'))
          .map((cookie) => {
            const [name, value] = cookie.split('=').map((c) => c.trim());
            return { name, value };
          });
        return cookies;
      };

      const waitForAxios = () => {
        if (typeof axios !== 'undefined') return Promise.resolve()
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          let attempts = 0
          const maxAttempts = 10

          const interval = setInterval(() => {
            if (typeof axios !== 'undefined') {
              clearInterval(interval)
              resolve()
            }
            if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
              clearInterval(interval)
              reject('Axios no cargó')
            }
            attempts++
          }, 100)
        })
      };

      const waitForCheckoutListener = () => {
        return new Promise(resolve => {
          const handlePong = (event) => {
            if (!isTrustedPinmapMessage(event)) return
            if (event.data?.type === "ping") {
              window.removeEventListener("message", handlePong)
              resolve(true)
            }
          }
          window.addEventListener("message", handlePong)
        })
      }

      const closeOpusCart = () => {
        querySelectorInShadow(OPUS_CLOSE_BUTTON_SELECTOR)[0]?.click()
      }

      const closeRebuyCart = () => {
        if (window.Rebuy?.SmartCart?.hide) {
          window.Rebuy.SmartCart.hide()
        } else {
          document.querySelector('#rebuy-cart-close')?.click()
        }
      }

      const closeCartDrawerApp = () => {
        document.querySelector('#cart-drawer-app .cd-cart-close-button')?.click()
      }

      const closeHorizonCartDrawer = () => {
        document.querySelector('dialog.cart-drawer__dialog[open] .cart-drawer__close-button')?.click()
      }

      const closeDawnCartDrawer = () => {
        document.querySelector('cart-drawer.active .drawer__close')?.click()
      }

      const displayPinmap = async () => {
        const body = document.querySelector('body')
        const logoUrl = document.querySelector('header > a > img')?.src

        let cart
        try {
          const res = await getCartData()
          cart = res.data
        } catch (err) {
          removeIframe()
          console.error(err)
          return
        }

        const usePinmap = localStorage?.getItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded')
        const trackingData = JSON.parse(localStorage?.getItem(NATIVE_TRACKING_DATA_STORAGE_KEY) || '{}')

        if (usePinmap === 'not loaded' || !isIframeIdentified) {
          await getMultiOriginData(cart)
          await sessionPromise
          fetch(TRACKING_PINMAP_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              ...getPinflagAuthHeaders()
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              id: cart?.token,
              storeName: trackingData?.companyName,
              timeOpenFirstStep: new Date(),
              cms: trackingData.cms,
              checkoutUsed: 'native',
              cartData: cart,
              pinflagApiKey: getPinflagIdentity(),
              device: navigator.userAgent,
              maxTouchPoints: navigator.maxTouchPoints,
              wasPinmapLeak: false
            })
          })
          .catch(err => console.error('Error enviando pinmap tracking:', err))

          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300))
          return window.location.replace('/checkout')
        }

        processMultiOriginInBackground(cart)

        try {
          const totalWeight = cart.total_weight
          sendCartData({
            cartItems: cart.items,
            cartToken: cart.token,
            checkoutId: getPinmapProCheckoutId(),
            logoUrl,
            totalWeight,
            cookies: getCookies()
          })
          applyRealMobileViewportBox()
          lockBodyScroll(body)
          localStorage.setItem('pinmap_flow', 'start')
          closeOpusCart()
          closeRebuyCart()
          closeCartDrawerApp()
          closeHorizonCartDrawer()
          closeDawnCartDrawer()
          document.querySelector(`${pmpModalOverlayClassv1}`).classList.add('overlay--active')
        } catch (err) {
          unlockBodyScroll(body)
          removeIframe()
          console.error(err)
        }
      };

      const displayPinmapRedirect = async () => {
        const body = document.querySelector('body')
        const logoUrl = document.querySelector('header > a > img')?.src

        let cart
        try {
          const res = await getCartData()
          cart = res.data
        } catch (err) {
          removeIframe()
          console.error(err)
          return
        }

        let tries = 0
        while (tries < 100) {
          tries++
          const usePinmap = localStorage?.getItem('pmpV1IsIframeLoaded')
          if (usePinmap === 'loaded') break
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
        }

        try {
          const totalWeight = cart.total_weight
          sendCartData({
            cartItems: cart.items,
            cartToken: cart.token,
            checkoutId: getPinmapProCheckoutId(),
            logoUrl,
            totalWeight,
            cookies: getCookies()
          })
          applyRealMobileViewportBox()
          lockBodyScroll(body)
          document.querySelector(`${pmpModalOverlayClassv1}`).classList.add('overlay--active')
        } catch (err) {
          unlockBodyScroll(body)
          removeIframe()
          console.error(err)
        }
      }

      function getCookie(name) {
        const cookies = document.cookie.split(';')
        for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          const cookie = cookies[i].trim();
          if (cookie.startsWith(name + '=')) {
            return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookie.substring(name.length + 1)))
          }
        }
        return null
      }

      // Function to calculate the closest form based on the DOM tree depth
      const findClosestForm = (button, forms) => {
        let closestForm = null;
        let minDistance = Infinity;

        forms.forEach((form) => {
          const distance = calculateDistance(button, form);
          if (distance < minDistance) {
            minDistance = distance;
            closestForm = form;
          }
        });

        return closestForm;
      };

      // Function to calculate distance between two elements in the DOM tree
      const calculateDistance = (el1, el2) => {
        const pathToEl1 = [];
        let current = el1;

        while (current) {
          pathToEl1.push(current);
          current = current.parentElement;
        }

        current = el2;
        let commonAncestorIndex = -1;
        while (current) {
          const index = pathToEl1.indexOf(current);
          if (index !== -1) {
            commonAncestorIndex = index;
            break;
          }
          current = current.parentElement;
        }

        return commonAncestorIndex === -1 ? Infinity : commonAncestorIndex;
      };

      const removeUrlParams = (paramNames) => {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href)
        paramNames.forEach((paramName) => url.searchParams.delete(paramName))
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, url.toString())
      }

      const checkRedirect = () => {
        const pendingStateIds = decodePendingStateIds(getCookie('pinflagPaymentRedirect'))
        const urlStateId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('state')

        if (!urlStateId || !pendingStateIds.includes(urlStateId)) return null

        return {
          success: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('success') === 'true',
          remainingStateIds: pendingStateIds.filter((stateId) => stateId !== urlStateId)
        }
      }

      const replacePinmapUrlIfRedirect = async () => {
        const redirectMatch = checkRedirect()
        if (redirectMatch) {
          if (redirectMatch.remainingStateIds.length) {
            setCookie('pinflagPaymentRedirect', JSON.stringify(encodePendingStateIds(redirectMatch.remainingStateIds)))
          } else {
            deleteHttpOnlyCookie('pinflagPaymentRedirect')
          }
          removeUrlParams(['state', 'success'])
          const pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1)

          if (pinmap) {
            document.querySelector('body').style.overflow = 'hidden'
            document.querySelector(pmpModalOverlayClassv1)?.classList.add('overlay--active')
            showRedirectSkeleton()

            pinmap.onload = async () => {
              await waitForAxios()
              await displayPinmapRedirect()
              await waitForCheckoutListener()

              hideRedirectSkeleton()

              pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage({
                type: "redirect-ready",
                origin: window.location.host,
                message: { success: redirectMatch.success },
                cms: 'shopify'
              }, '*')
            }
          }
        }
      };

      const getAddToCartForm = (formRef) => {
        if (formRef) return formRef;

        const pinflagButtonsByClass = document.querySelectorAll('.pinflag-pinmap-btn');
        const quickBuyButton = Array.from(pinflagButtonsByClass).find((button) => button.dataset.btn === 'quick-buy');

        if (!quickBuyButton) {
          console.error('Quick buy button not found');
          return null;
        }

        const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form[action="/cart/add"]');

        if (forms.length === 0) {
          console.error('No form with action /cart/add found');
          return null;
        }

        return findClosestForm(quickBuyButton, forms);
      };

      const buildAddToCartPayload = (form) => {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        if (isDawnPatchHost()) {
          formData.append('sections', 'cart-drawer,cart-icon-bubble');
          formData.append('sections_url', window.location.pathname);
        } else {
          formData.append('sections', 'header');
        }

        const formParams = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [k, v] of formData.entries()) formParams.append(k, v);

        return formParams;
      };

      const postAddToCart = (formParams) => {
        return fetch('/cart/add.js', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formParams.toString(),
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
        });
      };

      const clearAddToCartError = () => {
        document.getElementById(PINFLAG_ADD_TO_CART_ERROR_ID)?.remove();
      };

      const showAddToCartError = (form, data) => {
        clearAddToCartError();

        const message = document.createElement('div');
        message.setAttribute('id', PINFLAG_ADD_TO_CART_ERROR_ID);
        message.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
        message.textContent = data?.description?.trim() || ADD_TO_CART_ERROR_FALLBACK;

        form.insertAdjacentElement('beforeend', message);
        message.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
      };

      const addToCart = () => {
        // Find pinmap button that has quick-buy data attribute
        const form = getAddToCartForm();

        if (!form) {
          console.error('No form found');
          return;
        }

        const formParams = buildAddToCartPayload(form);

        clearAddToCartError();

        postAddToCart(formParams)
          .then(async (response) => {
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
              showAddToCartError(form, data);
              return;
            }

            updateHeaderSection(data?.sections?.header);
            displayPinmap();
          })
          .catch((error) => {
            console.error('error', error);
            showAddToCartError(form);
          });
      };

      const addToCartRefreshCart = (formRef) => {
        const form = getAddToCartForm(formRef);

        if (!form) {
          console.error('no /cart/add form found');
          return;
        }

        const formParams = buildAddToCartPayload(form);

        clearAddToCartError();

        return postAddToCart(formParams)
          .then(async (response) => {
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!response.ok) {
              showAddToCartError(form, data);
              return null;
            }

            updateHeaderSection(data?.sections?.header);
            displayPinmap();

            return data;
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error('error:', err);
            showAddToCartError(form);
            return null;
          });
      };

      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const target = e.target.id === OPUS_SHADOW_CONTAINER_ID
          ? e.composedPath().find(el => el.id === pmpButtonIdv1 || el.id === pmpButtonIdv1Modal || el.id === pmpCloseButtonIdv1)
          : e.target

        const pinmapButton = target?.closest(`#${pmpButtonIdv1}, #${pmpButtonIdv1Modal}`)

        if (pinmapButton) {
          e.preventDefault()
          const isQuickBuy = pinmapButton.dataset.btn === 'quick-buy'
          isQuickBuy ? addToCart() : displayPinmap()
        }

        if (target?.id === pmpCloseButtonIdv1) {
          closePinmap()
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener('rebuy:smartcart.show', function () {
        const isPinmapOpen = document.querySelector(pmpModalOverlayClassv1)?.classList.contains('overlay--active')
        if (isPinmapOpen) {
          setTimeout(closeRebuyCart, 0)
        }
      });

      window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
        if (!isTrustedPinmapMessage(event)) return;
        if (event.data?.origin === 'pinflag-shopify-pinmap-pro') {
          return messageHandler(event.data);
        }
      });

      replacePinmapUrlIfRedirect()
    },
    false
  );

  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function () {
    let pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1);
    pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage(
      {
        type: 'close-pinmap',
        origin: window.location.host,
        cms: 'shopify',
      },
      '*'
    );
  });

  function checkAbandonedCheckoutCookie() {
    var cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    var abandonedCheckoutCookieExists = false;

    for (var i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
      var cookie = cookies[i].trim();

      if (cookie.indexOf('abandonedCheckout=true') === 0) {
        abandonedCheckoutCookieExists = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!abandonedCheckoutCookieExists) {
      let pinmap = document.getElementById(pmpIframeIdv1);
      pinmap.contentWindow.postMessage(
        {
          type: 'close-pinmap',
          origin: window.location.host,
          cms: 'shopify',
        },
        '*'
      );

      var now = new Date();
      var expirationDate = new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000); // Expires in 30 minutes
      document.cookie = 'abandonedCheckout=true; expires=' + expirationDate.toUTCString() + '; path=/';
    }
  }

  const parsePhone = (phone) => {
    const strPhone = phone?.toString();
    if (strPhone?.length > 9) {
      return strPhone.replaceAll(' ', '').slice(-9);
    } else return strPhone;
  };
</script>
